theme_summary_ja: 1930年、ブラジル移民として新天地を求める人々が、神戸の移民収容所で出航までの日々を過ごす姿を群像劇として描く作品。多くは困窮した農村出身者で、期待と不安を抱えながら見知らぬ土地への船出を待つ。第1回芥川賞受賞作であり、後に続編を含む三部作として構成されている。
theme_summary_en: An ensemble drama set in 1930, following emigrants bound for Brazil as they wait out their final days before departure at an emigration lodge in Kobe. Most are impoverished farmers from the countryside, caught between hope and anxiety as they await passage to an unfamiliar land. Winner of the first Akutagawa Prize, the work was later expanded into a trilogy with two sequels.

theme_summary_ja: 中国・杭州の日本領事館に赴任した25歳の青年が、異国での孤独を抱えながら、領事館で働く現地の女性と密かな恋に落ちる物語。折しも国民革命軍の動きが強まり南京事件も起きる中、彼はやがて日本への帰国を余儀なくされる。異郷にいる日本人の疎外感と、束の間の恋の終わりを描いた作品。
theme_summary_en: A twenty-five-year-old man posted to the Japanese consulate in Hangzhou, China, falls into a secret love affair with a local woman who works at the consulate, even as he struggles with loneliness in a foreign land. As the Nationalist Revolutionary Army's advance intensifies and the Nanjing Incident erupts, he is eventually forced to return to Japan. The novel captures both the alienation of a Japanese expatriate abroad and the end of a fleeting romance.

theme_summary_ja: 和人による騙し討ちで一族の指導者たちを次々に失っていく、アイヌの若き首長コシャマインの物語。復讐を誓いながらも各地を転々とし、やがて和人への武力での抵抗が不可能であることを悟り、深い絶望のうちに生涯を終える。アイヌ民族と和人との抗争の歴史を、叙事詩的な文体で描いた作品。
theme_summary_en: The story of Koshamain, a young Ainu chieftain who watches the leaders of his people fall one after another to treacherous ambushes by the Wajin (ethnic Japanese). Vowing revenge, he wanders from place to place, but eventually comes to realize that armed resistance against the Wajin is futile, and dies in deep despair. Written in an epic register, the work chronicles the history of conflict between the Ainu and the Wajin.

theme_summary_ja: 中世フランスの女性詩人やジャンヌ・ダルクの伝記を書こうとする小説家の「私」が、旧友の妹で、特高警察に追われる非合法活動家の女性と再会する物語。奇矯な人物たちが次々と現れては生活に行き詰まっていく様を目の当たりにしながら、「私」は救済としての境地を希求していく。饒舌で衒学的な文体を用い、混沌とした現実の中で生きることを描いた作品。
theme_summary_en: A novelist narrator, "I," who is attempting to write biographies of a medieval French woman poet and of Joan of Arc, is reunited with the sister of an old friend—an underground activist being hunted by the Special Higher Police. As one eccentric character after another appears and finds their life reaching a dead end, the narrator yearns for some state of salvation. Written in a garrulous, erudite style, the work depicts the struggle to live amid a chaotic reality.

theme_summary_ja: パリで絵の勉強をする青年が、人妻に恋心を抱き、南フランスの地中海沿岸へ二人で不倫旅行に出かける物語。旅の途中で二人の関係はすれ違い始め、そこへ人妻の夫が姿を現し、青年に決闘を申し込む。フランスを舞台にした不倫と嫉妬、男同士の対決を描いた作品。
theme_summary_en: A young man studying painting in Paris falls in love with a married woman, and the two set off together on an illicit trip to the Mediterranean coast of southern France. As the journey progresses their relationship begins to fray, and then the woman's husband appears and challenges the young man to a duel. Set in France, the story depicts adultery, jealousy, and a confrontation between two men.

theme_summary_ja: 苦労を知らずに育った若妻と、貧しい暮らしを送る「私」との、極貧ながらも屈託のない結婚生活を描いた私小説的な短編集。生活は苦しいものの、なるようになると楽観する若妻ののんきな気性が、この夫婦の日々に明るさを与えている。表題作のほか複数の短編を収め、貧しさの中の温かい夫婦の情愛を描いた作品。
theme_summary_en: A collection of autobiographical-style short stories depicting the impoverished but carefree married life of "I," who lives in poverty, and his young wife, who was raised without knowing hardship. Though their circumstances are hard, the wife's easygoing, everything-will-work-out optimism brings a warmth to the couple's daily life. Alongside the title story, the collection gathers several other pieces that portray tender marital affection amid poverty.

theme_summary_ja: 九州の地方都市を舞台に、没落した農家の息子が糞尿(肥料)の汲み取り業に身を投じていく物語。地元の有力者の後ろ盾を得て市の指定業者となるが、事業が市営化されると利権の大半を有力者に奪われてしまう。地方政治のしたたかさと、そこに翻弄されながらもたくましく生きる庶民の悲喜こもごもを、ユーモアを交えて描いた作品。
theme_summary_en: Set in a provincial city in Kyushu, this novel follows the son of a ruined farming family who throws himself into the night-soil (fertilizer) collection trade. With the backing of a local power broker he becomes a city-designated contractor, but once the business is municipalized, most of the profits are seized by his patron. With a wry sense of humor, the work portrays the shrewdness of local politics and the bittersweet resilience of ordinary people buffeted by it.

theme_summary_ja: かつて共に一攫千金を夢見て全国の山を巡り歩いた二人の老人、代書屋を営む男と果樹園を営む男の晩年を描く物語。一方は若い頃に借りたわずかな金を、長年にわたってもう一方に何倍にもして返済し続けている。二人の間に横たわる貸し借りの因縁を通じて、若い頃の夢と老いた後の人生の落差を、菊の栽培という趣味に重ねて描いた作品。
theme_summary_en: A story of the old age of two men who once roamed the mountains of Japan together dreaming of striking it rich: one now runs a scrivener's shop, the other an orchard. For years the former has been repaying, many times over, a small sum he borrowed from the latter in his youth. Through the long-standing debt between them, and set against the shared hobby of chrysanthemum cultivation, the work depicts the gap between youthful dreams and the realities of old age.

theme_summary_ja: 日本人男性と結婚したフランス人女性のもとに、日本で暮らす他の外国人妻たちが集う交流を描いた物語。異国で暮らす女性たちがそれぞれの立場から国際結婚の生活を語り合う様子を通じて、当時の日本社会における異文化の受容や違和感が映し出される。芥川賞史上初めて女性作家が受賞した作品。
theme_summary_en: A French woman married to a Japanese man hosts gatherings of other foreign wives living in Japan, and the novel depicts their exchanges. As these women, each living far from home, discuss the realities of intercultural marriage from their own perspectives, the story reflects both the acceptance of and friction with foreign culture in Japanese society at the time. This was the first work by a woman writer to win the Akutagawa Prize.

theme_summary_ja: ロシア人の行商人が訪れた村を舞台に、村で一番気難しいと評判の老婆と彼との交流を描く物語。老婆から譲り受けた鶏が逃げ出してしまった騒動をきっかけに、老婆は初めて心を通わせたと感じるこの異邦人に助けを求めるようになる。異邦人と気難しい老婆との間に芽生える、ささやかな心の交流を描いた作品。
theme_summary_en: Set in a village visited by a Russian peddler, this story depicts his relationship with an old woman reputed to be the most cantankerous person in the village. When a chicken she gave him escapes and causes an uproar, the old woman turns for help to this foreigner—the first person, she feels, with whom she has truly connected. The work portrays the small, quiet bond that grows between a stranger and a difficult old woman.

theme_summary_ja: 昭和初期の東京・浅草の下町を舞台に、女性教師の手記という形式で、教え子である子供たちとその家族が抱える問題に向き合う物語。子供たちの不良化や病気の背景にある家庭環境を、教師の目を通して丹念に掘り下げていく。三つの章から成る連作形式で、下町に生きる子供たちの生活とそこに向き合う教育者の姿を描いた作品。
theme_summary_en: Set in the old downtown district of Asakusa, Tokyo, in the early Showa era, this work takes the form of a female teacher's memoir as she confronts the problems facing her pupils and their families. Through the teacher's eyes, it carefully examines the home environments underlying the children's delinquency and illness. Composed of three linked chapters, the work portrays both the lives of children in this working-class neighborhood and the educator who faces their struggles.

theme_summary_ja: 北方の海を舞台に、腕利きの猟師「豹」が白熊の密猟隊に加わる姿を描いた短編。厳しい自然の中での熊との命がけの闘いや、猟師仲間との人間模様を通じて、極北の地で生きる者たちの逞しさと孤独を浮かび上がらせている。著者自身が樺太で出会った老猟師との経験が作品の土台になっている。
theme_summary_en: A short story set on a northern sea, depicting a skilled hunter nicknamed "Leopard" who joins a party poaching polar bears. Through life-or-death struggles against bears amid harsh nature and the interplay among the hunters, it brings out the toughness and solitude of those who live in the far north. The work draws on the author's own experience meeting an old hunter in Sakhalin.

theme_summary_ja: 江戸時代中期の博物学者・発明家として知られる平賀源内の生涯を描いた歴史小説。エレキテルの復元や本草学の研究など多方面に才能を発揮しながらも、身分や時代の枠に収まりきらず苦悩する源内の姿を通じて、既成の秩序にとらわれない知識人の生き方を描いている。史実を踏まえつつ、その奇才ぶりと孤独を浮かび上がらせた作品。
theme_summary_en: A historical novel depicting the life of Hiraga Gennai, the naturalist and inventor of the mid-Edo period. Through the figure of Gennai—a man of prodigious, wide-ranging talents, from reconstructing the elekiter to studying herbal medicine, yet tormented by an inability to fit within the constraints of his social class and era—the novel portrays the life of an intellectual unbound by existing order. Grounded in historical fact, it brings out both his eccentric brilliance and his isolation.

theme_summary_ja: 日中戦争下の上海・南京・杭州を舞台に、日本人の文化工作員である三郎の目を通して、汪兆銘政権樹立前後の中国社会を描いた作品。汪を支持する中国人青年とそれに反対する姉、さらにポーランドから逃れてきたユダヤ人兄妹らが交錯し、混乱の時代を生きる人々の姿が描かれる。アジアの独立という理念を背景にしながら、当時の国際情勢の複雑さも映し出している。
theme_summary_en: Set in Shanghai, Nanjing, and Hangzhou during the Second Sino-Japanese War, this novel depicts Chinese society around the establishment of the Wang Jingwei regime through the eyes of Saburo, a Japanese cultural operative. The paths of a young Chinese man who supports Wang, his sister who opposes him, and a pair of Jewish siblings who have fled Poland all intersect, portraying people living through a chaotic era. Set against the ideal of Asian independence, the work also reflects the complexity of the international situation of the time.

theme_summary_ja: 昭和10年代の築地青果市場を舞台に、七人きょうだいの長女・八重が実家の青果問屋を切り盛りする姿を描いた作品。自由経済から統制経済へと移行する時代の波にのまれながらも、商売への執着と生活力によって家業を支えようとする女性の強さが描かれる。市場という庶民的な舞台を通して、時代の転換期を生きる働く女性の姿を浮かび上がらせている。
theme_summary_en: Set in the Tsukiji produce market during the 1930s and early 1940s, this novel follows Yae, the eldest of seven siblings, as she runs her family's wholesale produce business. Caught in the tide of an era shifting from a free market to a controlled economy, she is portrayed as a woman of strength who sustains the family trade through sheer tenacity and business acumen. Through the plebeian setting of the market, the work brings to life a working woman navigating a turning point in history.

theme_summary_ja: これといった取り柄のない主人公が一旗揚げようと中国大陸へ渡り、新聞社の従軍記者のために危険な連絡係の仕事を引き受ける物語。通信手段の乏しい戦時下の中国で、人づての伝達に頼る不便さや戦地の緊張感が描かれ、主人公は最後には流れ弾に倒れる。戦時下の名もなき一個人の生と死を淡々と描いた作品。
theme_summary_en: A man with no particular talents crosses over to mainland China hoping to make his fortune, and takes on dangerous work as a courier for a newspaper's war correspondents. In wartime China, where communication infrastructure is scarce, the story depicts the hardships of relying on word-of-mouth relay and the tension of the front lines; in the end, the protagonist is killed by a stray bullet. The work portrays, in a matter-of-fact tone, the life and death of one nameless individual during wartime.

theme_summary_ja: 中国東北部を舞台に、中国人地主に支配され小作を強いられるモンゴル人一家の姿を描いた作品。農耕に不向きなモンゴルの人々が中国社会への同化を強いられていく中で、娘に纏足を施そうとする親と、それになじめない子どもたちの姿が描かれる。主人公はそうした状況の中で次第にモンゴル民族としての誇りを見出していく。
theme_summary_en: Set in Manchuria, this novel depicts a Mongolian family forced into tenant farming under a Chinese landlord. As Mongolians, ill-suited to agriculture, are pressed to assimilate into Chinese society, the story portrays parents who try to bind their daughter's feet and children who cannot accept the practice. Amid these circumstances, the protagonist gradually comes to discover a sense of pride in being Mongolian.

theme_summary_ja: 福島県安達地方の和紙の産地・上川崎を舞台に、紙漉きに生きる人々の暮らしを描いた作品。伝統的な手漉き和紙づくりの工程や、それに携わる村人たちの心情を丹念に描写し、地方の生業と共同体の営みに光を当てている。選考でも文章の美しさと構成の緻密さが評価された。
theme_summary_en: Set in Kamikawasaki, in the Adachi region of Fukushima Prefecture—a center of traditional Japanese papermaking—this work portrays the lives of people who make their living from the craft. It carefully depicts the process of hand-making washi paper and the feelings of the villagers engaged in it, shedding light on a local trade and the workings of its community. The prize committee praised the work's beautiful prose and meticulous structure.

theme_summary_ja: 敗戦直後、混乱と虚脱感が残る大阪を舞台に、新聞社に勤める男が起死回生を懸けて大規模な闘牛興行を企てる物語。資金繰りや興行の采配に追われながら、一世一代の賭けに己の存在意義を見出そうとする主人公の姿を通して、焼け跡の時代を生きる人間の情念とエネルギーが描かれる。実際に大阪で行われた闘牛興行を題材にしたとされる作品。
theme_summary_en: Set in Osaka in the immediate aftermath of defeat, amid lingering chaos and exhaustion, this novel follows a newspaperman who stakes everything on staging a large-scale bullfighting exhibition as a last chance at reinvention. Beset by financing troubles and the demands of running the show, he seeks to find meaning in his existence through this once-in-a-lifetime gamble; the work captures the passion and energy of people living amid the ruins. It is said to be based on an actual bullfighting exhibition held in Osaka.

work_ja: 壁 S・カルマ氏の犯罪
theme_summary_ja: ある朝目覚めると自分の名前を失っていた男を主人公に、名刺に乗っ取られたアイデンティティや、自らの胸の中に「壁」ができていく不条理な世界を描いた作品。カフカ的な悪夢を思わせる筆致で、近代的な管理社会における個人の存在の希薄さや疎外感を寓話的に表現している。安部公房の実存主義的・前衛的な作風を代表する初期作。
work_en: The Wall: The Crime of Mr. S. Karma
theme_summary_en: The protagonist wakes one morning to find he has lost his own name, and the novel follows him through an absurd world in which his identity is usurped by a business card and a "wall" begins to grow inside his chest. In prose evoking a Kafkaesque nightmare, it renders, in allegorical form, the thinness of individual existence and the alienation bred by a modern administered society. This early work is representative of Abe Kobo's existentialist, avant-garde style.

theme_summary_ja: 朝鮮戦争が勃発した時期の東京を舞台に、新聞記者である主人公が、イデオロギー対立の激化する時代の中で独立した思考を保とうとする苦悩を描いた作品。政治的立場の分裂と圧力の中で、どちらの陣営にも与しきれない知識人の孤立感が主題となっている。冷戦下の日本社会における個人の自由と責任を問う作品。
theme_summary_en: Set in Tokyo at the time the Korean War broke out, this novel follows a newspaper reporter's struggle to maintain independent thought amid an era of intensifying ideological conflict. Its central theme is the isolation of an intellectual who, caught between political factions and their pressures, cannot fully align with either camp. The work interrogates individual freedom and responsibility within Cold War Japanese society.

theme_summary_ja: 剣豪小説というジャンルを切り拓いたとされる作品で、平常時は凡庸に見える若い剣士が、意識を失ったかのような無我の境地に入った時にのみ真の剣の冴えを発揮するという不思議な力を描く。剣の道における技と精神の関係、人智を超えた武の境地というテーマを幻想的な筆致で描いている。
theme_summary_en: Credited with opening up the genre of the swordsman novel, this work depicts a young swordsman who appears utterly ordinary in daily life but reveals true mastery of the blade only when he enters a trance-like state of selfless unconsciousness. In a fantastical style, it explores the relationship between technique and spirit in swordsmanship, and a level of martial attainment beyond human comprehension.

theme_summary_ja: 身体に障害を抱えながら、作家・森鷗外が小倉に赴任していた時期の空白を埋めようと生涯をかけて資料収集に打ち込んだ、実在の郷土史研究家をモデルにした作品。日の目を見ることのないまま終わった地道な研究に生涯を捧げた主人公の姿を通して、報われることのない努力の尊さと哀切を描いている。松本清張の代表的な初期作品の一つ。
work_en: An Account of a Certain 'Kokura Diary'
theme_summary_en: Modeled on a real local historian who, despite a physical disability, devoted his entire life to filling in the gap in the record of novelist Mori Ogai's posting to Kokura, this work portrays a man who dedicates his life to painstaking research that never sees the light of day. Through him, it depicts both the nobility and the sorrow of effort that goes unrewarded. It is one of Matsumoto Seicho's representative early works.

theme_summary_ja: 旧制中学時代、素行の悪い友人たちと付き合いながら鬱屈した青春を過ごす主人公の姿を描いた自伝的色彩の強い作品。反抗と挫折を繰り返す少年期の記憶を通して、戦中戦後の時代を生きた若者たちの屈折した心情を淡々とした筆致で描き出している。
theme_summary_en: A strongly autobiographical work portraying a protagonist who spends a frustrated adolescence keeping company with delinquent friends during his years at an old-system middle school. Through memories of a boyhood marked by repeated rebellion and setback, it depicts, in a restrained style, the twisted feelings of young people who lived through the war and postwar years.

theme_summary_ja: 娼婦の女性と関係を持つ男を主人公に、その場限りの肉体的な結びつきと、そこにふと芽生える情のようなものを描いた作品。「驟雨」というタイトルが示すように、突然訪れては過ぎ去っていく人間関係のはかなさが主題となっている。都会に生きる男女の乾いた関係性を通して、戦後の風俗と人間心理を描いている。
theme_summary_en: Centered on a man involved with a prostitute, this novel depicts a purely physical liaison in which something resembling affection unexpectedly takes root. As the title, Sudden Shower, suggests, its central theme is the fleeting nature of a relationship that arrives abruptly and just as abruptly passes. Through the emotionally detached bond between a man and woman living in the city, it portrays postwar mores and psychology.

work_ja: アメリカン・スクール
theme_summary_ja: 占領下の日本で、進駐軍関係者の子弟が通う「アメリカン・スクール」を見学することになった日本人英語教師たちの姿を描いた作品。英語が話せることを誇る教師と、アメリカへの複雑なコンプレックスを抱える別の教師との対比を通して、敗戦国民としての屈折した心理を諷刺的に描いている。占領期日本の精神状況を象徴的に切り取った作品として知られる。
theme_summary_en: Set in occupied Japan, this novel follows a group of Japanese English teachers on a visit to the "American School" attended by the children of occupation forces personnel. Through the contrast between a teacher proud of his English ability and another burdened with a complicated inferiority complex toward America, it satirically depicts the twisted psychology of a defeated nation's citizens. The work is known as a symbolic snapshot of the psychological state of occupation-era Japan.

theme_summary_ja: 会社を解雇された中年男性とその家族を中心に、一見平穏な郊外の家庭に忍び寄る静かな危機を描いた作品。プールサイドという穏やかな情景の裏側にある、家族間の微妙な心の揺れやすれ違いを丁寧に描写し、戦後の中流家庭が抱える不安を浮かび上がらせている。
theme_summary_en: Centered on a middle-aged man who has been fired from his company and his family, this novel depicts a quiet crisis creeping into a seemingly peaceful suburban household. Behind the placid scene of a poolside, it carefully renders the subtle emotional tremors and misunderstandings within the family, bringing to the surface the anxieties harbored by postwar middle-class households.

theme_summary_ja: ナチス占領下のフランスを舞台に、レジスタンスの闘士を拷問にかける冷酷な人物の内面を描いた作品。人間の中に潜む悪や残酷さ、そしてそれと表裏一体にある信仰の問題を追求し、「白い人」という題名には西欧的・理性的な人間像に潜む冷たさが込められている。遠藤周作が生涯のテーマとした罪と救済の問題を早くも提示した作品。
theme_summary_en: Set in Nazi-occupied France, this novel probes the inner life of a cold-blooded man who tortures a member of the Resistance. It pursues the evil and cruelty latent within human beings and, inseparable from it, the question of faith; the title, White Man, evokes the coldness lurking within the rational, Western image of humanity. The work is an early statement of the theme of sin and salvation that would occupy Endo Shusaku throughout his career.

notes: 『太陽の季節』は「太陽族」現象を生んだ社会的反響の大きい作品。著者の石原慎太郎は後に政治家に転身
theme_summary_ja: 戦後の湘南を舞台に、既成のモラルに縛られず享楽的に生きる裕福な家庭の若者たちの姿を描いた作品。ボクシングやヨットに興じ、恋愛にも奔放な主人公とその仲間たちの刹那的な生き方を通して、旧来の価値観を打ち破ろうとする戦後の「太陽族」と呼ばれた若者世代の気分を鮮烈に描き出した。発表当時、社会現象を巻き起こしたことでも知られる作品。
notes_en: "Season of the Sun" was a socially influential work that gave rise to the "Taiyozoku" (Sun Tribe) youth phenomenon. The author, Shintaro Ishihara, later became a politician.
theme_summary_en: Set in postwar Shonan, this novel portrays affluent young people who live hedonistically, unbound by conventional morality. Through the protagonist and his friends—who box, sail, and pursue love affairs with reckless abandon—it vividly captures the mood of the postwar generation that came to be known as the "Sun Tribe," bent on shattering old values through their momentary, headlong way of life. The work is also famous for having sparked a social phenomenon upon its publication.

theme_summary_ja: 海女が潜る漁村を舞台に、海に生きる家族の暮らしを描いた作品。厳しい自然と向き合いながら生計を立てる漁村の人々の姿や、親子の間に流れる複雑な感情を通じて、海とともにある土地の共同体の営みを描いている。
theme_summary_en: Set in a fishing village where women dive for shellfish and seaweed as ama divers, this novel depicts a family whose life is bound to the sea. Through the villagers who make their living confronting harsh nature, and the complicated feelings that flow between parent and child, it portrays the workings of a community whose existence is inseparable from the ocean.

theme_summary_ja: 太平洋戦争末期の硫黄島の戦いを題材にした作品。極限状況に置かれた兵士たちの姿を通して、戦場における人間の恐怖や葛藤を描き出している。戦争体験を扱った戦後文学の一つとして位置づけられる作品。
theme_summary_en: A novel based on the Battle of Iwo Jima at the end of the Pacific War. Through soldiers placed in extreme conditions, it depicts the fear and inner conflict of human beings on the battlefield. The work is positioned among the body of postwar literature dealing with wartime experience.

theme_summary_ja: 絵画教室を営む主人公が、裕福な会社社長の息子である内向的な少年と出会い、既成の枠にはまった絵しか描けなかった少年が次第に自分自身の表現を見出していく過程を描いた作品。物質的には恵まれていても心を開けない子どもの姿を通して、管理された戦後社会や教育のあり方への批評性を含んでいる。童話「裸の王様」を下敷きにした題名も印象的な作品。
theme_summary_en: The protagonist, who runs a painting class, meets an introverted boy—the son of a wealthy company president—who has only ever been able to paint within conventional bounds, and the novel traces the process by which the boy gradually discovers a mode of expression that is truly his own. Through this child, materially privileged yet unable to open his heart, the work carries a critique of postwar Japan's regimented society and its approach to education. Its striking title, borrowed from the fairy tale known in Japan as "The Naked King" (The Emperor's New Clothes), adds a further layer of resonance.

notes: 著者の大江健三郎は1994年にノーベル文学賞を受賞。芥川賞とノーベル賞の双方を受けた代表例
theme_summary_ja: 太平洋戦争末期、山深い村に撃墜されて捕虜となった黒人米兵と、彼を見張ることになった少年たちとの交流を描いた作品。当初は動物のように「飼育」されていた米兵と村の子どもたちとの間に芽生える奇妙な親密さと、それが暴力的に断ち切られていく結末を通して、戦争がもたらす純粋さの喪失と人間関係の残酷さを描いている。
notes_en: The author, Kenzaburo Oe, won the Nobel Prize in Literature in 1994. A leading example of a writer who won both the Akutagawa Prize and the Nobel Prize.
theme_summary_en: Set in a remote mountain village at the end of the Pacific War, this novel depicts the relationship between a Black American airman, shot down and taken prisoner, and the village boys assigned to guard him. At first treated almost like a captured animal, the soldier develops a strange intimacy with the children—an intimacy that is then violently severed. Through this arc, the work portrays the loss of innocence and the cruelty of human relations that war brings about.

theme_summary_ja: ナチス政権下のドイツの精神病院を舞台に、障害者の安楽死政策に組み込まれていく医療現場の医師たちの姿を描いた作品。人道と体制への服従の間で引き裂かれる医師たちの葛藤を通じて、全体主義の下での医療倫理と人間の尊厳の問題を描いている。
work_en: In a Corner of Night and Fog
theme_summary_en: Set in a psychiatric hospital in Nazi Germany, this novel depicts doctors who are drawn into the regime's euthanasia program targeting the disabled. Through their anguish—torn between humane conscience and obedience to the state—it examines questions of medical ethics and human dignity under totalitarian rule.

theme_summary_ja: 複雑な家庭の事情を抱えた男女が出会い、互いの過去の傷を受け入れながら結ばれていく様子を描いた恋愛小説。主人公「私」と、身内に不幸が重なった女性との静かで誠実な愛の物語を通して、家族の悲劇を乗り越えて生きようとする人間の姿を描いている。著者自身の体験を色濃く反映した作品としても知られる。
theme_summary_en: A love story in which a man and a woman, each carrying complicated family circumstances, meet and come together while accepting one another's past wounds. Through the quiet, sincere love story between the narrator, "I," and a woman who has suffered a succession of misfortunes within her family, it depicts people striving to live on after overcoming family tragedy. The novel is also known for closely reflecting the author's own experiences.

theme_summary_ja: 九州の捕鯨の村を舞台に、代々一族に祟りをもたらしてきたとされる巨大な白い鯨「鯨神」を追う漁師たちの姿を描いた作品。自然の脅威であり同時に神格化された存在でもある鯨と、それに挑む人間の執念とをダイナミックに描き、人間と自然の壮絶な闘いを主題としている。
theme_summary_en: Set in a whaling village in Kyushu, this novel depicts fishermen pursuing a gigantic white whale, called the "Whale God," said to have brought a curse upon their family line for generations. Dynamically portraying both the whale—at once a natural menace and a deified being—and the fierce obsession of the men who hunt it, the work takes as its theme an epic struggle between humanity and nature.

work_en: The Origin of a Beautiful Tale

theme_summary_ja: 女性の身体や病、性をめぐる屈折した心理を題材にした作品。日常の裏に潜む倒錯的な欲望や自己破壊的な衝動を、抑制の効いた文体で描き出し、女性の内面に潜む暗さと官能を掘り下げている。河野多惠子の作風を特徴づける初期の代表作の一つ。
theme_summary_en: A work centered on the twisted psychology surrounding a woman's body, illness, and sexuality. In a restrained, controlled style, it draws out the perverse desires and self-destructive impulses lurking beneath everyday life, probing the darkness and sensuality hidden within a woman's inner world. It is one of the representative early works that define Kono Taeko's distinctive style.

work_ja: 感傷旅行 センチメンタル・ジャーニィ
theme_summary_ja: 働く若い女性の恋愛模様を軽妙な筆致で描いた作品。大阪を舞台に、日常の中で揺れ動く恋心や失恋の痛みをユーモアを交えて描き、当時の若い女性の生き方や感性を等身大に映し出している。
theme_summary_en: A light, witty novel depicting the romantic entanglements of a young working woman. Set in Osaka, it portrays, with humor, the wavering emotions of love and the pain of heartbreak amid daily life, offering a true-to-life reflection of the outlook and sensibility of young women of the time.

theme_summary_ja: 1960年安保闘争を経験した学生たちのその後を描いた作品。理想を掲げて政治運動に身を投じながらも挫折し、日常へと戻っていく若者たちの喪失感や虚無感を、恋愛模様を交えながら描いている。安保世代の心情を代表する作品として広く読まれた。
theme_summary_en: This novel depicts the aftermath for students who lived through the 1960 Anpo (US-Japan Security Treaty) protests. Interweaving romantic entanglements, it portrays the sense of loss and emptiness felt by young people who threw themselves into political activism in pursuit of an ideal, only to be defeated and drift back into ordinary life. Widely read as a representative expression of the feelings of the Anpo generation.

theme_summary_ja: 東北の地を舞台に、母の死をめぐる記憶をたどる私小説的な作品。精神を病んで命を絶った母への複雑な思いと、それを見つめ続ける息子の視点から、家族の絆と喪失の痛みを静かな筆致で描いている。
theme_summary_en: Set in the Tohoku region, this autobiographical-style novel traces memories surrounding a mother's death. From the perspective of a son who continues to grapple with complicated feelings toward a mother who took her own life after suffering mental illness, it quietly depicts the bond between family members and the pain of loss.

theme_summary_ja: 死刑執行に立ち会う刑務官を主人公に、日常の勤めとして人の死に関わる仕事の重さと、そこから生まれる虚無感を描いた作品。淡々とした文体で綴られる刑務官の日々を通して、生と死が隣り合わせにある職務の非情さと、そこに埋没していく人間の心理を描き出している。
theme_summary_en: Centered on a prison officer who attends executions, this novel depicts the weight of a job in which dealing with death is simply part of the daily routine, and the sense of nihilism that grows out of it. Through the officer's days, rendered in a flat, matter-of-fact style, it portrays both the harshness of a duty in which life and death sit side by side, and the psychology of a man being slowly swallowed up by it.

work_ja: カクテル・パーティー
theme_summary_ja: アメリカ統治下の沖縄を舞台に、国際親善のカクテルパーティーで知り合った米国人・中国人・沖縄人たちの交流を描きながら、沖縄人の娘が米兵に暴行される事件をきっかけに、表面的な友好の裏にある占領という非対称な関係の欺瞞をあぶり出す作品。加害と被害、支配と被支配が複雑に絡み合う沖縄の戦後状況を鋭く描いた作品として知られる。
theme_summary_en: Set in Okinawa under American administration, this novel depicts the friendships formed among Americans, Chinese, and Okinawans at an international goodwill cocktail party—friendships whose surface amity is exposed as a sham when an Okinawan man's daughter is assaulted by a US serviceman, laying bare the asymmetry of the occupying relationship beneath it. The work is known for its incisive portrayal of postwar Okinawa's condition, in which victimizer and victim, ruler and ruled, are inextricably entangled.

theme_summary_ja: 長い年月を経て故郷に帰ってきた老人を中心に、変わりゆく故郷の風景や家族との再会を描いた作品。時の流れの中で失われていくものへの郷愁と、老いてなお故郷に根を持とうとする人間の姿を静かに描いている。
theme_summary_en: Centered on an old man who returns to his hometown after many years away, this novel depicts the changed landscape of home and his reunion with family. It quietly portrays both a nostalgia for what has been lost with the passage of time and a man who, even in old age, seeks to put down roots once again in his native place.

theme_summary_ja: 文壇や学界をめぐる人間模様を諷刺的に描いた作品。名誉や地位をめぐって繰り広げられる知識人たちの虚栄心や駆け引きを、ユーモアとアイロニーを交えて描き出し、老いや死を意識し始めた人物の心理も織り込んでいる。
theme_summary_en: A satirical novel of the goings-on within literary and academic circles. With humor and irony, it depicts the vanity and maneuvering of intellectuals jockeying for honor and status, while also weaving in the psychology of a figure who has begun to grow conscious of aging and mortality.

theme_summary_ja: アラスカに暮らす日本人妻を主人公に、異国での孤独や夫婦関係の空虚さ、女性としてのアイデンティティの揺らぎを描いた作品。日常に倦んだ主人公が場当たり的な逸脱行動に走る様を通じて、家庭という制度の中に閉じ込められた女性の抑圧された心理を描いている。
theme_summary_en: Centered on a Japanese wife living in Alaska, this novel depicts her loneliness in a foreign land, the hollowness of her marriage, and the instability of her identity as a woman. Through her impulsive, erratic acts of deviation, born of weariness with daily life, it portrays the repressed psychology of a woman confined within the institution of the family.

work_ja: 赤頭巾ちゃん気をつけて
theme_summary_ja: 1969年の東大安田講堂事件の余波が残る東京を舞台に、大学受験を控えた高校生の一日を描いた作品。学生運動の混乱や社会の変化を横目に見ながら、思春期の悩みや将来への漠然とした不安を独白調の軽やかな文体で綴っている。
work_en: Be Careful, Little Red Riding Hood
theme_summary_en: Set in Tokyo in the lingering aftermath of the 1969 Yasuda Hall siege at the University of Tokyo, this novel depicts a single day in the life of a high school student preparing for university entrance exams. Glancing sideways at the turmoil of the student movement and the changing society around him, it renders, in a light, monologue-like style, the anxieties of adolescence and a vague unease about the future.

theme_summary_ja: かつて日本の統治下にあった中国の港町・大連での少年時代の記憶を、望郷の思いを込めて綴った作品。アカシヤの並木が象徴する美しい異郷の街の記憶と、そこを追われるように去らねばならなかった喪失感が交錯し、失われた故郷への詩的な郷愁を描いている。
theme_summary_en: Written with a deep sense of longing, this work recounts the author's boyhood memories of the port city of Dalian in China, once under Japanese rule. Memories of a beautiful foreign city, symbolized by its avenues of acacia trees, intertwine with the sense of loss at having been driven from it, producing a poetic nostalgia for a homeland now lost.

theme_summary_ja: 第二次大戦末期、フランス領インドシナで日本軍がフランス軍を武装解除した事件の後、捕虜となった日本兵たちが収容された収容所を舞台にした作品。極限状況の中での兵士たちの人間模様や、戦争の大義と個人の生とのずれを、乾いた筆致で描いている。
theme_summary_en: Set in a prison camp holding Japanese soldiers taken captive after the Japanese army's disarming of French forces in French Indochina at the end of World War II, this novel portrays, in a spare, dry style, the interpersonal dynamics among soldiers in extreme conditions and the gap between the cause of war and individual survival.

theme_summary_ja: 山中で出会った精神的に不安定な女性・杳子と、彼女に惹かれていく男との関係を描いた作品。杳子の内面の混乱や現実感の希薄さを繊細に描写しながら、二人の間に生まれる危うい親密さと、それに巻き込まれていく男の心理の変容を追っている。内面描写を重視した「内向の世代」を代表する作品。
theme_summary_en: This novel depicts the relationship between Yoko, a psychologically unstable woman a man encounters in the mountains, and the man who becomes drawn to her. Delicately rendering the turmoil of Yoko's inner world and her tenuous grip on reality, it traces the precarious intimacy that grows between them and the transformation in the man's own psychology as he is drawn into it. The work is representative of the "Introverted Generation," known for its emphasis on inner psychological description.

theme_summary_ja: 樺太（サハリン）から引き揚げてきた在日朝鮮人の家庭を舞台に、幼くして亡くなった母への追憶を描いた作品。異国の地で苦労を重ねながら家族を支え続けた母の姿を、砧を打つ音という郷愁を誘う情景を通して描き出し、在日朝鮮人としてのアイデンティティと家族の記憶を主題としている。
theme_summary_en: Set within a Zainichi Korean family repatriated from Sakhalin, this novel recalls a mother who died when the narrator was still a child. It portrays a mother who endured hardship in a foreign land to support her family, evoked through the nostalgic image and sound of cloth being beaten on a fulling block, and takes as its themes Zainichi Korean identity and the memory of family.

theme_summary_ja: 米軍統治下の沖縄のコザを舞台に、米兵相手の商売を営む家庭に育つ少年の視点から、基地の街の日常を描いた作品。米兵や娼婦たちとの交流を通して、基地経済に翻弄される沖縄社会の現実と、その中で成長していく少年の複雑な心情を描いている。
theme_summary_en: Set in Koza, Okinawa, under American military rule, this novel depicts everyday life in a base town through the eyes of a boy raised in a family whose livelihood depends on trade with American soldiers. Through his encounters with servicemen and prostitutes, it portrays both the reality of an Okinawan society at the mercy of the base economy and the complicated feelings of a boy growing up within it.

work_ja: いつか汽笛を鳴らして
theme_summary_ja: 炭鉱の閉山が相次いだ時代の炭鉱町を舞台に、そこで教師として子どもたちと向き合う主人公の姿を描いた作品。産業の衰退とともに先行きの見えない町で暮らす子どもたちとの触れ合いを通して、変わりゆく地方社会の哀感を描き出している。
theme_summary_en: Set in a coal-mining town during an era of successive mine closures, this novel follows a schoolteacher who works with the local children. Through his encounters with children living in a town whose future has grown uncertain amid industrial decline, it captures the pathos of a regional society in the midst of change.

theme_summary_ja: 占領期以降の日本を舞台に、アメリカ人の父を持つ混血の子どもとその家族の暮らしを描いた作品。異なる文化や血筋を背負って生きる子どもの姿を通して、戦後日本社会における他者性や差別の問題を静かに描いている。
theme_summary_en: Set in Japan from the occupation era onward, this novel depicts the life of a mixed-race child with an American father and his family. Through this child, who carries a mixed cultural and ethnic heritage, it quietly addresses questions of otherness and discrimination in postwar Japanese society.

theme_summary_ja: 戦時下に学徒動員などを経験した世代の女性の視点から、戦争によって奪われた青春を回想する作品。同世代の友人たちの死や苦難を悼みながら、戦争体験を持つ世代の鎮魂の思いを込めて描かれている。
theme_summary_en: Told from the perspective of a woman of the generation mobilized as students during the war, this work recalls a youth stolen away by conflict. Mourning the deaths and sufferings of contemporaries, it is written as an act of requiem for a generation marked by wartime experience.

theme_summary_ja: 満州からの引き揚げ体験を持つ家族を描いた作品。敗戦とともに故国への帰還を強いられた家族が味わう困窮や喪失を、小鳥の「鶸（ひわ）」を象徴的なモチーフに用いながら描き、引き揚げ世代の記憶を静かに刻んでいる。
theme_summary_en: This novel depicts a family repatriated from Manchuria. Using the small bird known as the hawfinch as a symbolic motif, it portrays the hardship and loss endured by a family forced to return to their homeland after Japan's defeat, quietly inscribing the memory of the repatriate generation.

theme_summary_ja: 自衛隊に入隊した若者の新兵訓練の日々を描いた作品。厳しい規律の中で心身を鍛えられていく過程を通して、平和な時代における「兵」であることの意味と、若者の内面に潜む虚無や緊張感を描き出している。
theme_summary_en: This novel depicts the basic training days of a young man who has enlisted in Japan's Self-Defense Forces. Through the process of being disciplined in body and mind under strict regulations, it explores what it means to be a "soldier" in an age of peace, along with the emptiness and tension latent within the young man's inner life.

theme_summary_ja: 出羽三山の一つ、月山の麓にある寂れた寺で一冬を過ごすことになった主人公を描いた作品。雪に閉ざされた土地での孤独な生活と、そこに集う人々との交流を通して、生と死が隣り合う山岳信仰の風土と、瞑想的な人間の内面を描いている。
theme_summary_en: This novel follows a man who spends a winter at a remote, decaying temple at the foot of Mount Gassan, one of the three sacred peaks of Dewa. Through his solitary life in a land shut in by snow and his encounters with the people who gather there, it depicts both the mountain-worship culture in which life and death exist side by side, and a contemplative inner human landscape.

theme_summary_ja: キリスト教の信仰を持つ大阪の一家を舞台に、心を病んだ母親とその家族の姿を描いた作品。信仰と家族の絆、そして人間の弱さや脆さを見つめながら、著者自身の家族の記憶を色濃く投影した私小説的な作品となっている。
theme_summary_en: Set within a Christian family in Osaka, this novel depicts a mother suffering from mental illness and the family around her. Contemplating faith, family bonds, and human frailty, it is an autobiographical-style work that strongly reflects the author's own family memories.

theme_summary_ja: 長崎での被爆体験を持つ著者自身の記憶をもとに、原子爆弾投下の瞬間とその後の惨状を描いた作品。動員先の工場で被爆した少女の視点から、破壊された街と人々の姿を克明に描き出し、被爆者としての体験を文学として本格的に記録した初期の作品の一つとされる。
theme_summary_en: Based on the author's own memories as a survivor of the Nagasaki atomic bombing, this work depicts the instant of the bomb's detonation and its aftermath. Told from the perspective of a girl exposed to radiation at the factory where she had been mobilized, it renders the devastated city and its people in vivid detail, and is considered one of the earliest works to record the experience of an atomic bomb survivor in serious literary form.

theme_summary_ja: 紀州の被差別部落を思わせる「路地」と呼ばれる共同体を舞台に、日雇い労働者として働く青年を主人公にした作品。複雑に絡み合った血縁関係や、実の父親を含む土地の因習に縛られながら生きる主人公の姿を通して、血と土地に根差した人間の業を描いている。中上文学の出発点となった代表作。
theme_summary_en: Set in a community known as the "Alley" (roji), evocative of a discriminated-against buraku community in the Kishu region, this novel centers on a young day laborer. Through his life, bound by tangled blood ties—including that of his birth father—and by the customs of the land, it portrays a human karma rooted in blood and soil. The work is regarded as the foundational, representative text of Nakagami Kenji's literature.

work_ja: 限りなく透明に近いブルー
notes: 村上龍のデビュー作。選考では評価が大きく分かれた
theme_summary_ja: 米軍基地の街・福生を舞台に、ドラッグやセックスに耽溺する若者たちの退廃的な日常を描いた作品。感覚的で暴力的な描写を通して、戦後日本とアメリカの関係の中で行き場を失った若者たちの空虚さと、そこに漂う危うい生命力を描き出している。
notes_en: Ryu Murakami's debut work. Opinions among the judges were sharply divided.
theme_summary_en: Set in Fussa, a town near a US military base, this novel depicts the decadent daily lives of young people lost in drugs and sex. Through sensory, violent imagery, it portrays both the emptiness of youths who have lost their place within the postwar Japan-America relationship, and the precarious vitality that lingers beneath that emptiness.

theme_summary_ja: 1970年代の学生運動の余波が残る大学を舞台に、政治セクトに誘われながらも自分の立ち位置を見出せずにいる大学生の姿を描いた作品。周囲に流されやすい主人公の姿を通して、政治の季節が過ぎ去った後の若者たちの空虚感とアイデンティティの模索を軽妙な筆致で描いている。
theme_summary_en: Set on a university campus still feeling the aftershocks of the 1970s student movement, this novel depicts a student who, though courted by political factions, cannot find his own footing. Through a protagonist easily swayed by those around him, it portrays, in a light and witty style, the emptiness and search for identity of young people in the wake of a now-vanished political era.

theme_summary_ja: エーゲ海周辺を舞台に、芸術家である主人公の恋愛と創作をめぐる物語。異国の陽光あふれる風土を背景に、官能的な男女の関係と芸術への情熱を交錯させながら描いている。版画家としても知られた著者自身の感性が色濃く反映された作品。
theme_summary_en: Set around the Aegean Sea, this novel follows an artist protagonist through love affairs and the act of creation. Against a backdrop of sun-drenched foreign landscapes, it interweaves sensual relationships between men and women with a passion for art. The work strongly reflects the sensibility of its author, also well known as a printmaker.

theme_summary_ja: 昭和30年代の富山を舞台に、父の死と少年から青年へと成長していく主人公の姿を描いた作品。友人たちと出かけた川で蛍の大群に出会う幻想的な場面を軸に、家族の死という喪失と、思春期の淡い恋心や成長の記憶を叙情的に描いている。
theme_summary_en: Set in Toyama during the 1950s and 60s, this novel depicts a father's death and the protagonist's passage from boyhood into youth. Centered on a fantastical scene in which he and his friends encounter a great swarm of fireflies along a river, it lyrically portrays the loss of a family death alongside the faint stirrings of first love and the memories of growing up.

theme_summary_ja: 柔道に打ち込む高校生を主人公に、友情やライバルとの関係を通して成長していく姿を描いた作品。汗と挫折を重ねながら自分の生き方を模索する青春期の姿を、清々しい筆致で描いている。
theme_summary_en: Centered on a high school student devoted to judo, this novel depicts his growth through friendship and rivalry. In a fresh, clear-eyed style, it portrays the adolescent search for one's own way of life through accumulated sweat and setbacks.

work_ja: モッキングバードのいる町
theme_summary_ja: 占領期の日本で、アメリカ人兵士を父に持つ混血の子どもが直面する差別や孤独を描いた作品。異なる血を引くゆえに周囲から特別視される子どもの姿を、モッキングバードという異国の鳥に重ねながら、戦後日本社会の中の他者性の問題を描いている。
work_en: The Town Where the Mockingbird Lives
theme_summary_en: Set in occupation-era Japan, this novel depicts the discrimination and loneliness faced by a mixed-race child whose father is an American soldier. Likening the child—singled out by those around him because of his mixed blood—to the mockingbird, a bird foreign to Japan, it addresses the problem of otherness within postwar Japanese society.

theme_summary_ja: 老いて認知の衰えが進む父親と、その介護に向き合う家族の姿を描いた作品。かつての父の姿が徐々に失われていくのを見つめる息子の視点から、老いと家族の関係を、ユーモアとペーソスを交えながら描いている。前衛芸術家でもあった著者独自の視点が反映された作品。
theme_summary_en: This novel depicts an aging father in cognitive decline and the family who cares for him. From the perspective of a son watching his father's former self gradually slip away, it portrays old age and family relationships with a mixture of humor and pathos. The work reflects the distinctive viewpoint of an author who was also an avant-garde artist.

theme_summary_ja: 1981年にパリで実際に起きた日本人留学生による殺人事件、いわゆる佐川君事件に着想を得た作品。事件を起こした青年からの手紙という形式を用いながら、愛と殺意、正常と異常の境界が溶け合っていく人間の心の深淵を、劇作家でもある著者らしい幻想的な筆致で描いている。
theme_summary_en: Inspired by an actual 1981 murder in Paris committed by a Japanese exchange student—the so-called Sagawa case—this novel takes the form of letters written by the young man who committed the crime. In a fantastical style characteristic of an author who is also a playwright, it plumbs the depths of a human mind in which love and murderous intent, sanity and madness, dissolve into one another.

theme_summary_ja: 在米のユダヤ系アメリカ人と結婚した日本人女性を語り手に、ロサンゼルスでの国際結婚家庭の日常を描く自伝的色彩の強い作品。過越しの祭（パスオーバー）の食卓を軸に、異なる文化・宗教・価値観を持つ家族間の摩擦とユーモアを交えたやり取りが綴られる。子どもの教育やユダヤ人コミュニティとの関わりを通して、異文化の中でアイデンティティを保とうとする女性の視点が浮かび上がる。移民社会における家族のあり方を、軽妙な筆致で見つめた作品である。
theme_summary_en: Narrated by a Japanese woman married to a Jewish American man, this strongly autobiographical novel depicts the daily life of an intercultural family in Los Angeles. Centered on the Passover table, it recounts, with humor, the friction that arises among family members holding different cultures, religions, and values. Through the raising of children and engagement with the Jewish community, the perspective of a woman striving to preserve her identity amid another culture comes into focus. The novel takes a light, wry look at family life within an immigrant society.

theme_summary_ja: 一家が鍋を囲む団欒の場面を舞台に、祖母や母、孫娘という三世代の女性たちの会話を通して、戦争の記憶や家族の来し方が少しずつ明かされていく物語。何気ない食卓の会話の奥に、過去の傷や秘められた出来事が潜んでいることが徐々に浮かび上がる構成になっている。日常のささやかな営みと、そこに折り重なる大きな歴史・記憶との対比を静かに描いている。世代を超えて受け継がれていく記憶のありようをテーマにした作品である。
theme_summary_en: Set around a family gathered over a hot pot, this novel gradually reveals memories of war and the family's history through the conversation of three generations of women—grandmother, mother, and granddaughter. The structure slowly uncovers how old wounds and hidden events lie beneath the surface of casual dinner-table talk. It quietly contrasts the small routines of daily life with the weight of history and memory folded within them, taking as its theme the way memory is passed down across generations.

theme_summary_ja: 東京で単調な日々を送る青年である語り手が、寡黙で独特の哲学を持つ青年・染野と出会い、次第に親交を深めていく物語。染野は星や鉱物など宇宙的なスケールで世界を眺める人物で、彼との対話を通して語り手はものの見方を変えていく。やがて二人は貴金属の抽出に関わる、ある秘密めいた計画に加わることになる。日常に潜む静けさと、宇宙的な視野から人生を見つめ直す感覚を描いた作品である。
theme_summary_en: The narrator, a young man leading a monotonous life in Tokyo, meets Someno, a taciturn young man with a philosophy all his own, and gradually grows close to him. Someno views the world on a cosmic scale, through stars and minerals, and through his conversations with him the narrator's own outlook begins to shift. Eventually the two become involved in a somewhat secretive scheme involving the extraction of precious metals. The novel depicts a stillness hidden within everyday life and the sense of reconsidering one's existence from a cosmic vantage point.

work_en: The Eldest Son Becomes a Monk

theme_summary_ja: 雪深い信州の病院を舞台に、若い医師である語り手が、余命わずかな高齢のアメリカ人男性患者と向き合う物語。日本人妻と暮らしてきたこの外国人患者の最期に付き添う中で、語り手は生と死、そして異国で生涯を終えることの意味を静かに見つめ直していく。極寒の朝に舞う「ダイヤモンドダスト」という氷の結晶現象が、儚くも美しい生の終わりの象徴として描かれる。医療の現場から人の死と向き合う姿を描いた作品である。
theme_summary_en: Set at a hospital deep in the snows of Shinshu, this novel follows a young doctor-narrator attending to an elderly American patient with only a short time left to live. In accompanying this foreign patient—who has spent his life with a Japanese wife—through his final days, the narrator is led to quietly reconsider life and death, and the meaning of ending one's life in a foreign land. "Diamond dust," the shimmering ice-crystal phenomenon that appears on bitterly cold mornings, serves as a symbol of a fleeting yet beautiful end to life. The novel portrays a confrontation with human death from within a medical setting.

theme_summary_ja: 韓国のソウルにある大学に留学した在日コリアンの女性・由煕を、彼女を見守る下宿先の家族の視点から描いた物語。日本で生まれ育った由煕は、自らのルーツである韓国語や韓国社会になじもうと努力するが、言葉や文化の壁の前でどこにも安住の地を見出せない苦しみを抱えている。日本と韓国のどちらにも完全には属せない在日コリアンのアイデンティティの揺らぎが、繊細な筆致で描かれる。国境や民族の境界の間で引き裂かれる個人の内面を見つめた作品である。
theme_summary_en: This novel portrays Yuhi, a Zainichi Korean woman studying at a university in Seoul, through the eyes of the family that hosts her as a lodger and watches over her. Born and raised in Japan, Yuhi struggles to adapt to the Korean language and society that are, in principle, her own roots, yet suffers from an inability to find a place of belonging anywhere in the face of linguistic and cultural barriers. With delicate prose, the novel depicts the instability of a Zainichi Korean identity that belongs fully to neither Japan nor Korea. It is a work that looks closely at an individual torn between national and ethnic boundaries.

work_en: In the Town Where They Keep What They Find

theme_summary_ja: 中国のある地方を舞台に、そこに実在するとされる小さな村を探し求める日本人の主人公を描いた物語。旅を進めるうちに、村の名前や存在そのものが人によって語ることが違い、記憶と伝聞、現実の境界が次第にあいまいになっていく。訪れるはずの土地が幻のように揺らいでいく不安な感覚が、静かな筆致で描かれる。旅と記憶、そして探し求めるものの実在をめぐる寓意的な作品である。
theme_summary_en: Set in a region of China, this novel follows a Japanese protagonist searching for a small village said to actually exist. As his journey progresses, accounts of the village's name and even its very existence differ from person to person, and the boundaries between memory, hearsay, and reality grow increasingly blurred. In a quiet, understated style, the novel conveys the unsettling sense of a destination dissolving like a mirage. It is an allegorical work about travel, memory, and the reality of the thing one seeks.

theme_summary_ja: 姉の妊娠をきっかけに、その経過を日記形式で綴っていく妹を語り手とした物語。つわりに苦しむ姉のために、語り手はグレープフルーツでジャムを作ってやるなど献身的に世話をするが、その眼差しには次第にかすかな違和感や不穏さがにじんでいく。妊娠という生命の始まりを見つめる語り手の視線が、純粋な祝福だけではない複雑な感情を帯びていく様子が描かれる。身体や生殖をめぐる不安と冷ややかな観察眼が同居する作品である。
theme_summary_en: Narrated by a younger sister who keeps a diary chronicling her older sister's pregnancy, this novel follows her devoted care for the sister, who suffers from morning sickness—she even makes her grapefruit jam—even as a faint unease and disquiet gradually seep into her gaze. The narrator's view of pregnancy, the beginning of a new life, comes to carry emotions far more complicated than pure celebration. It is a work in which anxiety about the body and reproduction coexists with a coolly observant eye.

theme_summary_ja: 放送局の宿直勤務者を決まった時間に起こす「起こし屋」というアルバイトに従事する若者を描いた物語。語り手は仮眠室を回り、眠っている職員を起こして回るという単調で特殊な仕事を通して、組織の中で働く人間の孤独や機械的な日常を見つめる。効率化・システム化された労働の中で、人と人との関わりがどのように変質していくかが静かに描かれる。現代的な労働と人間性の希薄化を扱った作品である。
theme_summary_en: This novel depicts a young man working a part-time job as a "waker," rousing overnight staff at a broadcasting station at their appointed times. Making his rounds of the nap rooms to wake sleeping employees, the narrator, through this monotonous and peculiar task, observes the loneliness and mechanical rhythm of life for a person working within an organization. It quietly portrays how human connection is altered by increasingly efficient, systematized labor. The work addresses modern labor and the thinning-out of human presence.

theme_summary_ja: 都市の交通機関で働く運転士を主人公に、繰り返される単調な勤務とその中に潜む緊張感を描いた物語。決められた時刻表とマニュアルに従って運行を続ける仕事を通して、個人の感情や意思がシステムに組み込まれていく様子が浮かび上がる。管理された都市生活の中で、働く者の内面がどのように扱われるかが静かに見つめられる。現代社会における労働と人間性の関係を問う作品である。
theme_summary_en: Centered on a train operator working within a city's transit system, this novel depicts a repetitive, monotonous job and the tension latent within it. Through the work of operating a train strictly according to a fixed timetable and manual, it reveals how a person's own feelings and will become absorbed into the system. The novel quietly examines how the inner life of a worker is treated within a highly managed urban existence, and questions the relationship between labor and humanity in contemporary society.

theme_summary_ja: 郊外の塾で子供たちに勉強を教える独身女性のもとに、ある日犬のような風貌の見知らぬ男が現れ、二人は同居を始めるという物語。近隣の住民たちはこの奇妙な同居関係を噂し合い、女性と男との関係を詮索していく。日本の昔話「犬婿入り」を下敷きにしながら、女性の欲望や自立、共同体の視線といったテーマを、幻想と日常が入り混じる文体で描いている。伝統的な説話を現代的に読み替えた寓話的作品である。
theme_summary_en: One day, a strange man with a dog-like appearance turns up at the home of a single woman who teaches at a suburban cram school, and the two begin living together. The neighbors gossip about this odd cohabitation and pry into the relationship between the woman and the man. Drawing on the Japanese folktale "The Dog Bridegroom," the novel—titled in English The Bridegroom Was a Dog—explores themes of female desire, independence, and communal scrutiny in a style that blends the fantastical with the everyday. It is a fable-like reworking of a traditional tale for the modern age.

theme_summary_ja: 太平洋戦争でフィリピン戦線を経験した男が、戦後、石集めに没頭するようになる物語。地質学的な視点から石の来歴をたどる行為が、彼自身が抱える戦争の記憶やトラウマと重なり合っていく。平穏に見える戦後の家庭生活の底に、癒えない過去の傷が横たわっていることが徐々に明らかになる。個人の記憶と地層としての時間の堆積を重ね合わせた作品である。
theme_summary_en: This novel follows a man who fought in the Philippines during the Pacific War and, after returning home, becomes absorbed in collecting stones. The act of tracing each stone's geological history comes to overlap with his own buried memories and trauma from the war. Beneath a postwar family life that appears calm, an unhealed wound from the past gradually comes into view. The work layers personal memory over the sedimented strata of time itself.

work_ja: タイムスリップ・コンビナート
theme_summary_ja: 夢と現実の境界が溶け合うような意識の流れの中で、ある女性が工業地帯（コンビナート）を訪れる体験を描いた物語。前後の脈絡が定かでない断片的な情景やイメージが積み重なり、語り手の内面の混沌がそのまま文体に反映されている。都市の周縁に広がる工業地帯という無機質な風景が、女性の孤独や不安定な自己意識と響き合う。実験的な文体で女性の内的世界を描いた作品である。
theme_summary_en: Within a stream of consciousness in which the boundary between dream and reality dissolves, this novel depicts a woman's experience of visiting an industrial complex. Fragmentary scenes and images, their sequence uncertain, accumulate on the page, the narrator's inner chaos reflected directly in the prose style itself. The inorganic landscape of an industrial zone on the city's periphery resonates with the woman's loneliness and unstable sense of self. It is a work that renders a woman's inner world through an experimental style.

theme_summary_ja: 特に大きな事件は起きないまま、語り手がかつて親しかった女性とその家族を久しぶりに訪ねる、静かな日常を描いた物語。会話や何気ない時間の推移そのものを丹念に描写することで、人と人との関係の「敷居」のようなものを浮かび上がらせている。劇的な展開よりも、時間の流れや気配の変化を捉えることに主眼が置かれている。淡々とした日常描写を通して人間関係の機微を見つめた作品である。
theme_summary_en: With no major incident really taking place, this novel depicts the quiet everyday experience of a narrator visiting, after a long interval, a woman he was once close to and her family. By carefully rendering conversation and the mere passage of ordinary time, it brings into view something like the "threshold" that exists between people. Its focus lies not in dramatic developments but in capturing the flow of time and shifts in atmosphere. It is a work that observes the subtleties of human relationships through understated depictions of daily life.

theme_summary_ja: 沖縄のある島を舞台に、居酒屋に迷い込んだ一匹の豚をきっかけに、店で働く女性たちとその常連客の青年が、祟りを恐れて聖地（御嶽）へお祓いに向かう物語。旅の道中、それぞれが抱える傷や過去と向き合っていくことになる。沖縄の伝統的な信仰や共同体の記憶が、コミカルさとせつなさを交えて描かれる。土地に根づいた霊的な世界観と人々の再生を描いた作品である。
theme_summary_en: Set on an island in Okinawa, this novel begins when a pig wanders into a small bar, prompting the women who work there and a young regular customer, fearing a curse, to set off for a sacred site (utaki) to have it purified. Along the way, each of them is forced to confront wounds and past experiences of their own. Traditional Okinawan beliefs and communal memory are depicted with a blend of comedy and pathos. The novel portrays a spiritual worldview rooted in the land, and the renewal of the people who live within it.

theme_summary_ja: 道端で蛇を踏んでしまった女性の前に、その蛇が老女の姿に化けて現れ、「あなたの母親です」と言って家に上がり込んでくるという物語。奇妙な同居生活が始まる中で、語り手は日常と非日常の境界が曖昧になっていく感覚に包まれていく。淡々とした語り口で描かれる不条理な出来事が、かえって現実の危うさを浮かび上がらせる。日常に忍び込む異界との遭遇を描いた幻想的な作品である。
theme_summary_en: A woman accidentally steps on a snake in the road, and the snake later appears before her transformed into an old woman, announcing "I am your mother" before moving into her home. As this strange cohabitation begins, the narrator finds herself enveloped in a sense that the line between the everyday and the uncanny has grown indistinct. Absurd events, narrated in a flat, matter-of-fact voice, only heighten the precariousness of reality. It is a fantastical work depicting an encounter with another world that creeps into ordinary life.

theme_summary_ja: 北海道・函館の刑務所で看守を務める主人公が、ある日入所してきた受刑者が、かつて自分をいじめていた小学校時代の同級生であることに気づく物語。加害者と被害者だった過去の関係が、看守と受刑者という新たな立場で再び交錯していく。津軽海峡を望む港町を舞台に、消えない記憶と赦しをめぐる感情の揺れが描かれる。過去と向き合うことの痛みと再生を見つめた作品である。
theme_summary_en: The protagonist, a prison guard at a facility in Hakodate, Hokkaido, discovers one day that a newly admitted inmate is a former elementary school classmate who once bullied him. Their earlier relationship, as bully and victim, now re-intersects in the new roles of guard and prisoner. Set in a port town overlooking the Tsugaru Strait, the novel depicts the emotional turbulence surrounding an inescapable memory and the question of forgiveness. It is a work that contemplates the pain, and the possibility of renewal, in confronting the past.

theme_summary_ja: 長年ばらばらに暮らしてきた家族が、映画撮影という名目で数年ぶりに一堂に会し、「幸せな家族」を演じるカメラの前に立たされる物語。演技として求められる仲睦まじさと、実際の家族関係に横たわる不和や傷とのギャップが露わになっていく。在日コリアンの家族を背景に、家族という制度そのものの虚構性が問い直される。演じることと生きることの境界を鋭く見つめた作品である。
theme_summary_en: A family that has long lived scattered and apart is gathered together for the first time in years, ostensibly to appear in a film, and made to stand before the camera performing the role of a "happy family." The gap between the harmony demanded by the performance and the real discord and wounds within the family gradually comes into the open. Against the backdrop of a Zainichi Korean family, the novel interrogates the fictional nature of the family as an institution itself. It is a work that sharply examines the boundary between performing and living.

theme_summary_ja: 沖縄戦を生き延びた老人のもとに、ある夜突然、彼の片脚から水が滴り始めるという物語。やがて、沖縄戦で命を落とした兵士たちの亡霊が夜な夜な現れ、その水を飲みに来るようになる。かつて戦場で老人が犯した過去の行いが、幻想的な出来事を通して徐々に明らかにされていく。沖縄戦の記憶と罪の意識を、マジックリアリズム的手法で描いた作品である。
theme_summary_en: One night, water inexplicably begins dripping from the leg of an old man who survived the Battle of Okinawa. Before long, the ghosts of soldiers who died in that battle begin appearing night after night to drink the water. Through this fantastical occurrence, an act the old man committed on the battlefield long ago is gradually brought to light. The novel uses a magical-realist technique to depict the memory of the Battle of Okinawa and the burden of guilt.

theme_summary_ja: カトリック系の児童養護施設を舞台に、そこで育った青年が抱える暴力性や性、信仰との葛藤を描いた物語。施設内での虐待や暴力の連鎖の中で、主人公は自らの内なる衝動と向き合っていく。宗教的な赦しや罰といったモチーフが、生々しい暴力描写と交錯しながら展開する。閉ざされた環境の中で育まれた歪みと救済を問う作品である。
theme_summary_en: Set at a Catholic children's home, this novel depicts a young man raised there and the violence, sexuality, and conflicts of faith he carries within him. Amid a cycle of abuse and violence within the institution, the protagonist confronts his own inner impulses. Motifs of religious forgiveness and punishment unfold intertwined with raw depictions of violence. It is a work that questions both the distortion bred within a closed environment and the possibility of redemption from it.

work_ja: ブエノスアイレス午前零時
theme_summary_ja: 雪深い温泉町のダンスホールを舞台に、そこで働く主人公とタンゴを踊る女性との関わりを描いた物語。場末の温泉地という閉塞感のある土地で紡がれる、ほろ苦い人間関係が静かに綴られる。タンゴの旋律や踊りが、登場人物たちの満たされない思いや郷愁を象徴的に彩っていく。地方の温泉町を舞台にした、哀愁ただよう作品である。
theme_summary_en: Set in a dance hall in a snowbound hot-spring town, this novel depicts the bond between the protagonist who works there and a woman who dances the tango with him. Quietly recounted, it is a bittersweet relationship woven within the stifling confines of a rundown resort town. The melodies and movements of the tango color the characters' unfulfilled longings and nostalgia. It is a melancholic work set in a provincial hot-spring town.

theme_summary_ja: 中世末期のヨーロッパを舞台に、神学と錬金術を学ぶ若き修道士が、ある錬金術師のもとで両性具有的な存在と出会う物語。異端とされる思想や禁じられた知に触れる中で、主人公の信仰と理性は大きく揺さぶられていく。物語は、日食が起こる中で行われる異端審問と火刑という劇的な場面へと収斂していく。中世ヨーロッパを舞台に、信仰と異端、理性と神秘の相克を描いた作品である。
theme_summary_en: Set in late-medieval Europe, this novel follows a young monk studying theology and alchemy who, through an alchemist, encounters an androgynous being. As he comes into contact with heretical ideas and forbidden knowledge, his faith and reason are profoundly shaken. The story converges on a dramatic climax—an inquisition and burning at the stake carried out during a solar eclipse. Set in medieval Europe, the work depicts the conflict between faith and heresy, reason and mystery.

theme_summary_ja: 大阪の在日コリアンが多く暮らす地域を舞台に、そこで生きる人々の暮らしと人間関係を描いた物語。主人公を含む登場人物たちは、それぞれに抱える屈折した過去や社会の片隅での居場所のなさと向き合っている。在日コリアンコミュニティの持つ独特の温かさと厳しさが、地に足のついた筆致で描かれる。マイノリティとして生きる人々の生活実感を掬い取った作品である。
theme_summary_en: Set in an Osaka neighborhood with a large Zainichi Korean population, this novel depicts the lives and relationships of the people who live there. The protagonist and the other characters each grapple with their own troubled pasts and a sense of having no place within the margins of society. The distinctive warmth and harshness of the Zainichi Korean community are rendered in grounded, unadorned prose. It is a work that captures the lived reality of people living as a minority.

theme_summary_ja: 中年の男である語り手の、とりとめのない意識の流れをそのまま文章化したような物語。過去の記憶と現在の出来事が脈絡なく入り混じり、独特のリズムを持った文体で語られていく。仕事や家族といった日常のしがらみからずれていく主人公の姿が、シュールでユーモラスな筆致で描かれる。既存の小説的な構成を解体するような、実験的な語りの作品である。
theme_summary_en: This novel reads as though the rambling stream of consciousness of its middle-aged male narrator has been transcribed directly onto the page. Past memories and present events mingle without clear connection, narrated in a prose with its own peculiar rhythm. The protagonist, gradually drifting away from the everyday entanglements of work and family, is portrayed in a surreal, humorous style. It is an experimental work of narration that dismantles conventional novelistic structure.

theme_summary_ja: 長崎を舞台に、隠れキリシタン以来の歴史を背負ったカトリック信仰共同体の人々の暮らしを描いた物語。登場人物たちは、代々受け継がれてきた信仰と、現代の日常生活との間で揺れ動きながら生きている。長崎という土地に刻まれた殉教や弾圧の記憶が、静かな筆致で織り込まれていく。信仰と土地の記憶を見つめた作品である。
theme_summary_en: Set in Nagasaki, this novel depicts the lives of a Catholic community carrying a history that reaches back to the era of the hidden Christians. Its characters live suspended between a faith handed down across generations and the realities of modern daily life. The memory of martyrdom and persecution etched into the land of Nagasaki is woven quietly into the narrative. It is a work that contemplates the relationship between faith and the memory of a place.

theme_summary_ja: フランス・ノルマンディー地方に暮らす旧友を訪ねた語り手が、その地で共に過ごす数日間を描いた物語。友人はユダヤ系の血を引く人物で、二人の会話や散策の端々に、彼の家族が背負ってきた歴史の重みがにじみ出てくる。派手な事件は起きないまま、旅先での穏やかな時間の中に、記憶と喪失についての静かな思索が織り込まれていく。異国での友情を通して歴史と向き合う作品である。
theme_summary_en: The narrator visits an old friend living in Normandy, France, and this novel recounts the few days they spend together there. The friend is of Jewish descent, and the weight of the history his family has carried seeps through the edges of their conversations and walks together. With no dramatic incident taking place, quiet reflections on memory and loss are woven into the calm, unhurried time spent abroad. It is a work that confronts history through the medium of friendship in a foreign land.

theme_summary_ja: 地方の寺の住職を務める僧侶を主人公に、檀家の人々の死や看取りに寄り添う日々を描いた物語。仏教でいう「中陰」、すなわち死者が次の生へと向かうまでの中間の期間をめぐる思索が、物語全体を貫くテーマとなっている。死にゆく人とその家族に向き合う中で、主人公は生と死のあわいにあるものの意味を問い直していく。禅僧である著者の実感に基づいた、死生観を静かに見つめた作品である。
work_en: The Flower of the Interim Realm
theme_summary_en: Centered on a Buddhist priest serving as the head of a rural temple, this novel depicts his daily life accompanying parishioners through death and dying. A meditation on chuin—the Buddhist concept of the intermediate period between a person's death and their next rebirth—runs through the entire work as its guiding theme. In facing the dying and their families, the priest is led to reconsider the meaning of what lies in the interval between life and death. Grounded in the lived experience of an author who is himself a Zen priest, it is a quiet contemplation of views on life and death.

theme_summary_ja: 父親のいない家庭で、破天荒でエネルギッシュな母親に育てられる少年を語り手にした物語。母は車を猛スピードで走らせるような奔放さを持ちながらも、息子との日々を懸命に生きている。地方の団地暮らしを舞台に、型にはまらない母子の絆と、少年の目から見た大人の世界が描かれる。ユーモアの中に温かさをたたえた家族の物語である。
theme_summary_en: Narrated by a boy raised, in the absence of a father, by his wild and energetic mother, this novel follows a woman who drives at reckless speed and lives just as freely, yet devotes herself wholeheartedly to her days with her son. Set in a provincial public housing complex, it depicts an unconventional bond between mother and son, and the world of adults as seen through a boy's eyes. It is a family story suffused with warmth beneath its humor.

theme_summary_ja: 東京・日比谷公園を舞台に、公園のベンチで見知らぬ女性と知り合った主人公の男が、彼女との淡い交流を重ねていく物語。公園という都市の中の特別な空間で行き交う人々の姿を通して、都会に暮らす人々の孤独やささやかなつながりが描かれる。大きな事件は起こらないまま、日常の中の小さな発見や出会いが積み重ねられていく。都市生活者の心情を静かに切り取った作品である。
theme_summary_en: Set in Hibiya Park in Tokyo, this novel follows a man who meets a woman he does not know on a park bench, and their gentle, fleeting exchanges. Through the people who pass through the park—a special space carved out within the city—it depicts the loneliness and small connections of urban life. With no major incident taking place, small discoveries and encounters accumulate within the everyday. It is a work that quietly captures the feelings of those who live in the city.

theme_summary_ja: かつての教え子の女性と再会した中学校教師の男が、彼女との関係にのめり込んでいく物語。女性への執着は次第に暴力的で常軌を逸したものへと変わっていき、主人公自身もその関係に飲み込まれていく。タイトルの「ハリガネムシ」は、宿主を操って行動を支配する寄生虫を指し、抜け出せない執着や支配関係の比喩となっている。人間関係における狂気と依存を描いた作品である。
theme_summary_en: A middle school teacher, reunited with a former female student, becomes utterly absorbed in a relationship with her. His obsession with her gradually turns violent and unhinged, and he himself is swallowed up by the relationship. The title, Harigane Mushi (Hairworm), refers to a parasite that manipulates and controls its host's behavior, serving as a metaphor for an inescapable obsession and a relationship of domination. The novel depicts madness and dependency within a human relationship.

notes: 綿矢りさは当時歴代最年少(19歳)での受賞として話題に
theme_summary_ja: 渋谷の街で出会ったピアスショップの店員の男に惹かれた19歳の女性が、舌先を分岐させる「スプリットタン」に憧れ、身体改造の世界にのめり込んでいく物語。恋人の暴力性やもう一人の刺青彫り師の男との関係を通して、痛みと快楽、そして自らの身体を作り変えていくことの意味が描かれる。若者の刹那的な生き方とアイデンティティの模索が、乾いた筆致で綴られる。現代の若者の孤独と痛みを描いた作品である。
notes_en: Risa Wataya drew attention as the youngest winner in the prize's history at the time (age 19).
theme_summary_en: A nineteen-year-old woman is drawn to a man working at a piercing shop in Shibuya, and, aspiring to a "split tongue," plunges into the world of body modification. Through her boyfriend's violence and her relationship with another man, a tattoo artist, the novel depicts pain and pleasure, and the meaning of remaking one's own body. The reckless, momentary way of life of youth and the search for identity are rendered in a dry, spare style. It is a work that depicts the loneliness and pain of contemporary young people.

notes: 綿矢りさは当時歴代最年少(19歳)での受賞として話題に
theme_summary_ja: クラスに馴染めない女子高生の語り手が、同じく孤立している男子生徒に対して抱く、苛立ちにも似た微妙な感情を描いた物語。その男子生徒はあるモデルの追っかけに夢中になっており、語り手はなぜか彼に惹かれつつも素直になれない。思春期特有の孤独や、人との距離の取り方に悩む若者の心理が繊細に描かれる。誰にも打ち明けられない思春期の孤独を見つめた作品である。
notes_en: Risa Wataya drew attention as the youngest winner in the prize's history at the time (age 19).
work_en: I Want to Kick You in the Back
theme_summary_en: The narrator, a high school girl who cannot fit into her class, harbors a subtle emotion—something akin to irritation—toward a male classmate who is likewise isolated. This boy is obsessed with following a certain model around, and the narrator, for reasons she cannot quite name, finds herself drawn to him while unable to be honest about it. The novel delicately depicts the loneliness peculiar to adolescence and the difficulty young people have in gauging emotional distance from others. It is a work that gazes at an adolescent loneliness that can be confided to no one.

theme_summary_ja: 祖母の介護をする青年を語り手に、その日々の苦労と葛藤をラップのようなリズムを持った独特の文体で綴った物語。大麻や音楽といった主人公の生活の断片が、介護という重い現実と隣り合わせに描かれる。家族の介護という誰もが直面しうる問題を、既存の「美談」とは異なる生々しい視点で見つめている。介護する者の本音を赤裸々に描いた作品である。
theme_summary_en: Narrated by a young man caring for his grandmother, this novel renders his daily hardships and inner conflicts in a distinctive prose style with the rhythm of rap. Fragments of the protagonist's life—marijuana, music—sit side by side with the heavy reality of caregiving. It looks at the problem of family caregiving, something anyone might face, from a raw perspective quite unlike the conventional "heartwarming tale." It is a work that lays bare the unvarnished true feelings of a caregiver.

work_ja: グランド・フィナーレ
theme_summary_ja: ある事件をきっかけに家庭も職も失った男が、故郷の東北の町に戻ってくる物語。かつて栄えた地方都市の姿と、そこで再出発を図ろうとする主人公の姿が重ね合わせて描かれる。地域の人々との関わりの中で、主人公は自らが犯した過ちや家族との関係を見つめ直していくことになる。喪失からの再生を、地方都市を舞台に描いた作品である。
theme_summary_en: A man who has lost both his family and his job following an incident returns to his hometown in Tohoku. The novel overlays the image of a provincial city that once thrived with the figure of a protagonist trying to make a fresh start there. Through his interactions with the local community, he comes to reexamine the mistakes he has made and his relationship with his family. It is a work depicting renewal after loss, set in a provincial city.

theme_summary_ja: 幼い頃に虐待を受けた過去を持つ青年を主人公に、その心に刻まれたトラウマと、痛みや暴力への屈折した感情を描いた物語。過去に受けた仕打ちを反復するかのような行動に、主人公自身が引き寄せられていく様子が描かれる。加害と被害、支配と服従が入り混じった感覚の中で、生きることの意味が問われていく。虐待の記憶が人格に及ぼす影響を見つめた作品である。
theme_summary_en: Centered on a young man who was abused as a child, this novel depicts the trauma etched into his mind and his twisted feelings toward pain and violence. It portrays him being drawn, as if compelled, toward actions that repeat the very abuse once done to him. Amid a tangled sense of victimizer and victim, dominance and submission, the meaning of being alive is called into question. It is a work that examines the effect the memory of abuse has upon a person's character.

theme_summary_ja: 同期入社の男女社員が、互いに「先に死んだ方のパソコンのデータを、もう片方が必ず消す」という約束を交わす物語。当たり前の日常を共にしてきた同僚同士の友情が、その約束を通して静かに描かれる。会社員として働く中での喜びや戸惑いが、飾らない筆致で綴られる。働く男女のさりげない友情と約束の重みを描いた作品である。
theme_summary_en: A man and a woman who joined the same company in the same year make a pact: whichever of them dies first, the other will delete the data on their computer. Through this promise, the novel quietly depicts the friendship between two colleagues who have shared an ordinary working life together. The joys and small confusions of office work are rendered in an unadorned style. It is a work that portrays the understated friendship, and the weight of a promise, between a working man and woman.

theme_summary_ja: 離婚に向けた話し合いを進める夫婦の夫を主人公に、自動販売機の飲料を補充するアルバイトをしながら過ごす日々を描いた物語。かつての結婚生活を振り返りながら、関係が終わっていくことへの実感のなさや戸惑いが淡々と綴られる。特別な事件のない日常の描写を通して、夫婦関係の終わりという出来事の重みが浮かび上がる。平凡な日常の中の喪失感を見つめた作品である。
theme_summary_en: Centered on a husband whose marriage is in the process of ending in divorce, this novel follows his days working a part-time job restocking vending machines. Looking back on his past married life, he records, in a flat, unemotional tone, his own lack of feeling and bewilderment at the relationship's dissolution. Through the depiction of an uneventful daily life, the weight of a marriage's ending comes quietly into view. It is a work that examines the sense of loss embedded within the ordinary.

theme_summary_ja: 定職に就かないまま実家を出た20歳の女性が、遠縁にあたる高齢の女性の家に間借りして暮らし始める物語。年の離れた二人の同居生活と、様々なアルバイトを転々とする主人公の日々が、淡々とした筆致で描かれる。将来への確かな見通しを持てないまま、その時々を生きる若者の姿が浮かび上がる。自分の居場所を探す若い女性の心情を描いた作品である。
work_en: A Fine Day to Be Alone
theme_summary_en: A twenty-year-old woman leaves her family home without settled employment and begins renting a room in the house of an elderly distant relative. In a flat, understated style, the novel depicts the cohabitation of these two women of very different ages, and the protagonist's days spent drifting from one part-time job to another. It brings into view a young person living moment to moment without any firm sense of the future. It is a work that portrays the feelings of a young woman searching for a place of her own.

theme_summary_ja: 突然「ポンパ」など意味不明な言葉を発するようになった叔父の失踪をきっかけに、語り手がその叔父の日記をひもといていく物語。言葉にならない衝動や、日常の意味から逸脱しようとする叔父の生き方が、断片的に明らかにされていく。小説を書くという行為そのものについての省察が、物語の随所に織り込まれている。言葉と意味、そして「小説」という形式そのものを問い直す実験的な作品である。
theme_summary_en: After an uncle who has begun uttering nonsensical words like "Ponpa" disappears, the narrator sets out to decipher his uncle's diary. Fragment by fragment, the novel reveals an inarticulate impulse within the uncle and a way of living bent on escaping the meanings of everyday life. Reflections on the very act of writing a novel are woven throughout the narrative. It is an experimental work that interrogates language and meaning, and the very form of the "novel" itself.

theme_summary_ja: 豊胸手術に強いこだわりを見せる大阪の母親と、母との会話を拒み、ノートに思いを書き綴ることでしか意思疎通しない娘が、語り手である叔母のもとを訪ねてくる物語。三日間ほどの東京滞在を通して、女性の身体や老い、母娘関係をめぐる複雑な感情が浮かび上がっていく。関西弁のリズムを生かした語り口で、女であることの生々しい実感が描かれる。女性の身体と家族関係を見つめた作品である。
theme_summary_en: An Osaka mother fixated on getting breast enlargement surgery, and her daughter, who refuses to speak to her and communicates only by writing her thoughts in a notebook, come to visit the narrator, their aunt. Over roughly three days in Tokyo, complicated feelings surrounding the female body, aging, and the mother-daughter relationship rise to the surface. Told in a narrative voice that draws on the rhythms of Kansai dialect, the novel captures the raw, visceral reality of being a woman. It is a work that examines the female body and family relationships.

theme_summary_ja: 1980年代末の中国で学生時代を過ごし、民主化を求める運動の高まりとその挫折を目の当たりにした青年が、後に日本へ渡り生きていく物語。中国と日本という二つの国を行き来しながら、政治的な理想と現実の間で揺れ動いた青春の記憶が描かれる。日本語を母語としない書き手による作品として、言語や国境を越える経験そのものも重要なモチーフとなっている。激動の時代を生きた一人の青年の軌跡を描いた作品である。
theme_summary_en: A young man who spends his student years in China in the late 1980s, witnessing firsthand the rise and subsequent crushing of the pro-democracy movement, later crosses over to Japan to build a life there. Moving between the two countries, the novel depicts memories of a youth caught between political ideals and reality. As a work by a writer for whom Japanese is not a native language, the very experience of crossing languages and borders becomes an important motif in itself. It traces the path of one young man who lived through a turbulent era.

theme_summary_ja: 工場の契約社員として働く女性が、自分の時給を計算し、それが世界一周旅行の費用にどれほど相当するかを思い巡らせる物語。地道な労働と、決して楽ではない生活の中に見出されるささやかな希望や連帯が描かれる。観葉植物のポトスライムが、変わらぬ日常の中でゆっくりと育っていく様子と、主人公の暮らしが重ね合わされる。現代の労働と生きることの意味を静かに見つめた作品である。
theme_summary_en: A woman working as a contract employee at a factory calculates her hourly wage and muses over how much of a trip around the world it might add up to. The novel depicts the modest hope and solidarity found within diligent labor and a life that is far from easy. The slow growth of a potted pothos plant amid her unchanging daily routine is set alongside the protagonist's own life. It is a work that quietly contemplates the meaning of work and of living in the present age.

theme_summary_ja: 結婚してから長い年月を経た夫婦の、特に劇的な出来事のないまま過ぎていく日常を描いた物語。互いへの関心の薄れや距離感を抱えながらも、共に暮らし続けてきた歳月そのものが淡々と綴られていく。時間の経過とともに移り変わる夫婦の情感の機微が、独特の飛躍のある文体で描かれる。長い結婚生活の実感を見つめ直した作品である。
theme_summary_en: This novel depicts the undramatic, everyday life of a married couple many years into their marriage. Even as a diminished interest in one another and a certain emotional distance persist between them, the novel plainly records the years they have simply gone on living together. The subtle shifts in a couple's feelings over the passage of time are rendered in a prose style marked by distinctive leaps and elisions. It is a work that reconsiders what it truly feels like to be in a long marriage.

theme_summary_ja: 外国語専門学校でドイツ語を学ぶ女子学生たちが、アンネ・フランクの日記の一節をドイツ語で暗唱する弁論大会に向けて練習を重ねる物語。「証言すること」と「本当のこと」との間の隔たりをめぐり、学生たちの間に微妙な緊張や競争が生まれていく。アンネの日記というテクストを媒介に、若い女性たちの自意識や虚栄心が浮き彫りにされる。証言と真実、そして女性の自己顕示欲を見つめた作品である。
theme_summary_en: A story about female students at a foreign-language academy studying German who rehearse for a speech contest in which they must recite a passage from Anne Frank's diary from memory, in German. As they prepare, a subtle tension and rivalry develops among them over the gap between "bearing witness" and "telling the truth." Using the text of Anne Frank's diary as a lens, the novel lays bare the self-consciousness and vanity of these young women. A work that examines testimony, truth, and female self-display.

theme_summary_ja: 幼い頃に葉山の別荘で共に過ごした二人の女性が、25年ぶりに再会する物語。互いの記憶に残る子供時代の情景と、大人になった現在の時間が交錯しながら語られていく。断片的な記憶が夢のように行き来する構成を通して、時間や記憶のあいまいさが描かれる。過ぎ去った時間と再会がもたらす感情の揺れを描いた作品である。
theme_summary_en: A story of two women, once childhood companions at a family villa in Hayama, reuniting after twenty-five years apart. The narrative moves fluidly between scenes from their remembered childhood and their present lives as adults. Through a structure in which fragmentary memories drift back and forth like a dream, the novel captures the elusiveness of time and memory. A work that traces the emotional undertow stirred up by years gone by and an unexpected reunion.

theme_summary_ja: 定時制高校を中退し、港湾での日雇い労働をしながらその日暮らしを続ける青年を主人公にした、著者の自伝的要素の強い物語。荒んだ生活の中で酒や女性関係に溺れながらも、どこか文学に憧れを抱く主人公の姿が描かれる。社会の底辺で生きる若者の孤独と自己嫌悪、そしてかすかな向上心が入り混じって綴られる。私小説の系譜を継ぐ作品である。
theme_summary_en: A heavily autobiographical novel centered on a young man who has dropped out of night school and drifts through a hand-to-mouth existence doing day labor on the docks. Mired in drink and troubled relationships with women, he nonetheless harbors a half-hidden longing for literature. The narrative interweaves the loneliness and self-loathing of a young man living at society's margins with a faint, persistent yearning to rise above his circumstances. A work that carries on the tradition of the Japanese confessional "I-novel."

theme_summary_ja: 着想やアイデアを蝶のように捕らえる「網」を持つという架空の作家をめぐり、複数の語り手や時代、そして翻訳という行為が入れ子状に絡み合っていく物語。物語の中に物語が埋め込まれ、誰が語っているのかが次第に判然としなくなっていく実験的な構成を持つ。小説を書くこと、読むこと、翻訳することそのものが主題として扱われている。虚実の境界を溶かすメタフィクション的な作品である。
theme_summary_en: A novel built around a fictional writer said to possess a "net" for capturing ideas and inspirations the way one catches butterflies, its multiple narrators, eras, and the act of translation nesting inside one another like Russian dolls. Stories are embedded within stories in an experimental structure where it gradually becomes unclear who is speaking. The very acts of writing, reading, and translating fiction are themselves the subject. A metafictional work that dissolves the boundary between the real and the invented.

theme_summary_ja: 川沿いの町で暮らす17歳の少年が、女性に暴力を振るう父親の血を自分も受け継いでいるのではないかという不安と向き合う物語。父親と同じように暴力的な性衝動を抱え始めた自分自身に、少年は恐れとともに気づいていく。父の内縁の妻や実の母親との関係を通して、暴力の連鎖から逃れられるかどうかが問われる。血と暴力の遺伝というテーマを扱った、生々しい青春小説である。
theme_summary_en: A seventeen-year-old boy living in a river town confronts his fear that he has inherited his father's violent nature toward women. With mounting dread, he recognizes in himself the same violent sexual impulses his father displays. Through his relationships with his father's common-law wife and his own mother, the novel asks whether he can break free from this cycle of violence. A raw coming-of-age novel that grapples with the inheritance of blood and violence.

theme_summary_ja: かつて裕福だったが没落した家庭に育った女性が、障害を負った夫とともに、家族がかつて縁のあった温泉旅館を訪れる物語。夫の介護をしながら過ごす旅を通して、女性は自らの生い立ちや家族の栄光と没落を振り返っていく。華やかだった過去と、地味で不自由な現在との対比が静かに描かれる。介護と家族史を織り交ぜて生の意味を問う作品である。
work_en: Touring the Land of the Dead
theme_summary_en: A woman raised in a once-prosperous family that later fell into decline travels with her disabled husband to a hot-spring inn her family had ties to in the past. Caring for her husband along the way, she reflects on her upbringing and on her family's rise and fall. The novel quietly juxtaposes a glittering past with a plain, constrained present. A work that weaves caregiving together with family history to ask what gives life its meaning.

theme_summary_ja: 一般的な句読点や表記の慣習にとらわれない、独特の文体で綴られた実験的な物語。ある女性の幼少期からの記憶や日常が、時系列を解体するような形式で描かれていく。従来の小説の書き方そのものに挑むような文体が最大の特徴で、内容以上にその文章表現の実験性が高く評価された。日本語の小説の形式そのものを問い直す前衛的な作品である。
theme_summary_en: An experimental novel written in a highly idiosyncratic style that disregards conventional punctuation and orthography. It renders one woman's memories, from childhood onward, and her daily life in a form that dismantles chronological order. Its defining feature is a prose style that challenges the very conventions of novelistic writing, and it was praised above all for the experimental daring of its language rather than its content. An avant-garde work that reexamines the very form of the Japanese novel.

theme_summary_ja: 母を亡くした幼い女の子が、父の再婚相手である若い継母を「あなた」と二人称で語る、独特の視点を持った物語。子供でありながら大人びた冷ややかな観察眼で継母を見つめる語り手の視線が、不穏な緊張感を生み出していく。家庭という閉じた空間の中で育まれる歪んだ親密さと違和感が描かれる。少女の視点から家族の危うさを見つめた作品である。
theme_summary_en: Told from a distinctive vantage point, this is the story of a young girl who has lost her mother and addresses her father's new, young wife directly as "you," in the second person. The narrator's gaze -- that of a child who observes her stepmother with an oddly adult, cool detachment -- generates a quiet, unsettling tension throughout. The novel depicts the warped intimacy and lingering unease that take root within the closed world of a household. A work that views the precariousness of family through a young girl's eyes.

theme_summary_ja: 夫の転勤に伴い、夫の実家がある田舎町に引っ越してきた専業主婦の女性を主人公にした物語。ある日、川沿いで見慣れない生き物を追ううちに、奇妙な穴に落ちてしまう。そこから彼女は、夫の家族や近所の人々をめぐる不可思議な出来事に次々と遭遇していく。のどかな田舎の日常に潜む奇妙さと閉塞感を、静かな筆致で描いた作品である。
theme_summary_en: The protagonist is a housewife who has moved to the rural town where her husband's family lives after his job transfer. One day, while chasing an unfamiliar creature along a riverbank, she falls into a strange hole. From there she is drawn into a series of inexplicable incidents involving her husband's family and the local townspeople. Written in a quiet, understated style, the novel reveals the strangeness and suffocating closeness lurking beneath the placid surface of rural daily life.

theme_summary_ja: 取り壊しが決まった古いアパートに暮らす主人公が、隣に建つ、かつて写真集の舞台になった洋館に興味を持つようになる物語。隣人の女性とともにその洋館について調べていく過程で、土地や建物に刻まれた過去の記憶が浮かび上がってくる。再開発によって移り変わっていく街の風景と、そこに積み重なる人々の記憶が対比的に描かれる。都市の変化の中で失われゆくものを見つめた作品である。
theme_summary_en: The protagonist lives in an old apartment building slated for demolition and becomes fascinated by a Western-style mansion next door that once served as the setting for a photography book. As she investigates the mansion's history together with a female neighbor, memories embedded in the land and the building itself gradually surface. The novel sets the shifting cityscape brought about by redevelopment against the layered memories of the people who once lived there. A work that contemplates what is lost amid urban transformation.

theme_summary_ja: 発達に困難を抱える息子を連れて、九州の故郷の町に戻ってきたシングルマザーの女性を主人公にした物語。九年前、まだ息子を身ごもる前にヨーロッパを旅した際の出来事が、現在の彼女の心情と重ね合わされて回想される。故郷の人々との関わりの中で、彼女は息子と生きていくことへの不安や祈りにも似た思いを抱いていく。母親としての痛みと祈りを描いた作品である。
theme_summary_en: A single mother returns with her developmentally disabled son to her hometown in Kyushu. Interwoven with her present state of mind are memories of a trip she took through Europe nine years earlier, before she had conceived her son. Through her interactions with the people of her hometown, she comes to hold both anxiety and something like a prayer for the life she must build with her son. A work depicting a mother's pain and her prayerful hope.

work_ja: スクラップ・アンド・ビルド
notes: 又吉直樹はお笑いコンビ「ピース」のメンバーで、芸能人による受賞として大きな話題に
theme_summary_ja: 「早く死にたい」と口にする祖父と同居する、定職に就いていない青年を主人公にした物語。青年は祖父の介護をしながら、なぜか自分自身の肉体改造、ボディビルディングにのめり込んでいく。祖父の「死にたい」という願いに応えようとする一方で、皮肉にも自らの肉体を鍛え上げていく青年の姿が、ブラックユーモアを交えて描かれる。介護と若者の焦燥感を対比的に描いた作品である。
notes_en: Naoki Matayoshi is a member of the comedy duo "Peace," and his win drew major attention as an award to a celebrity entertainer.
theme_summary_en: An unemployed young man lives with his grandfather, who constantly says he wants to die soon. While caring for his grandfather, the young man inexplicably throws himself into bodybuilding, transforming his own body. The novel, laced with dark humor, depicts the irony of a young man laboring to sculpt his physique even as he tries to honor his grandfather's wish to die. A work that sets caregiving against a young person's restless sense of urgency.

notes: 又吉直樹はお笑いコンビ「ピース」のメンバーで、芸能人による受賞として大きな話題に
theme_summary_ja: 花火大会の営業先で出会った若手漫才師の主人公が、独特の感性を持つ先輩芸人に弟子入りを志願し、師弟のような関係を結んでいく物語。主人公は漫才師として売れることを目指しながらも、その先輩芸人の生き方や芸に対する姿勢に強く惹かれていく。何年にもわたる二人の交流を通して、笑いや芸に人生をかけることの厳しさとおかしみが描かれる。お笑いという世界を舞台に、師弟の絆と挫折を描いた作品である。
notes_en: Naoki Matayoshi is a member of the comedy duo "Peace," and his win drew major attention as an award to a celebrity entertainer.
