theme_summary_en: A young manzai comedian meets a senior performer with an idiosyncratic sensibility while working a fireworks-festival gig, and asks to become his apprentice, forging a mentor-disciple bond between them. While the protagonist aims to make it as a comedian himself, he finds himself increasingly drawn to his mentor's way of life and his approach to the craft. Over years of their association, the novel captures both the harshness and the absurd comedy of staking one's life on making people laugh. Set in the world of comedy, this is a story of a bond between mentor and disciple, and of setbacks along the way.

theme_summary_ja: ある人物の通夜に集まった大人数の親族たちの、それぞれの視点や会話が入れ替わり立ち替わり描かれる群像劇。故人を悼む場でありながら、集まった親族たちのなにげない会話や思い出話、ちょっとした諍いが淡々と綴られていく。特定の主人公を置かず、複数の視点を渡り歩く構成によって、家族という集まりの雑多な現実感が浮かび上がる。通夜という場を通して家族の姿を見つめた作品である。
theme_summary_en: An ensemble piece that shifts continually among the viewpoints and conversations of the many relatives gathered for a wake. Though it is meant as an occasion of mourning, the novel dispassionately records the casual chatter, shared reminiscences, and petty frictions among the assembled family. With no single protagonist, its structure of shifting perspectives brings out the messy, unglamorous reality of a family gathering. A work that examines the shape of a family through the occasion of a wake.

theme_summary_ja: 専業主婦の女性が、いつしか自分の顔や仕草が夫にそっくりになっていることに気づく物語。長年連れ添ってきた夫婦が互いに似ていく現象を、どこかユーモラスかつ不気味に描いている。古くからの「異類婚姻譚」（人と異なるものとの結婚をめぐる説話）を下敷きにしながら、現代の夫婦関係における同化や自己喪失を問い直している。日常に潜む奇妙さを通して結婚という制度を見つめた作品である。
theme_summary_en: A housewife realizes one day that her face and mannerisms have come to closely resemble her husband's. The novel treats the well-known phenomenon of long-married couples growing to resemble one another with a mixture of humor and eeriness. Drawing on the old folk-tale tradition of the "marriage-to-a-non-human" tale, it reexamines the assimilation and loss of self that can occur within a modern marriage. A work that scrutinizes the institution of marriage through the strangeness hidden within everyday life.

theme_summary_ja: 18年間コンビニでアルバイトを続けてきた36歳の女性を主人公にした物語。感情表現や社会的な振る舞いが独特で、これまで「普通」になろうと周囲を模倣し続けてきた彼女にとって、マニュアル化されたコンビニの仕事だけが自分の居場所だと感じられる。結婚もせず定職にも就かない彼女に対する家族や友人からの無言のプレッシャーが、彼女を追い詰めていく。「普通」であることを強いる社会のまなざしを問い直す作品である。
theme_summary_en: The protagonist is a thirty-six-year-old woman who has worked part-time at a convenience store for eighteen years. Her emotional responses and social behavior have always struck others as unusual, and having spent her life mimicking those around her in an effort to seem "normal," she finds that only the fully manualized routine of convenience-store work gives her a true sense of belonging. The silent pressure from family and friends over her unmarried, jobless status gradually closes in on her. A work that questions society's insistence on conformity to "normal" life.

theme_summary_ja: 北海道の辺境にある演劇塾に入門した19歳の青年を主人公にした物語。カリスマ的な指導者のもとに集まった若者たちとの、共同生活にも似た厳しい稽古の日々が描かれる。都会とは切り離された特殊な環境の中で、演劇という表現に向き合いながら成長していく青年の姿が綴られる。著者自身の経験を色濃く反映した、青春群像劇である。
theme_summary_en: A nineteen-year-old young man enrolls at a remote theater academy in Hokkaido, and the novel depicts the grueling regimen of rehearsals, lived almost communally, among the young people gathered under a charismatic instructor. Cut off from urban life in this singular environment, the protagonist grows as he confronts the art of theatrical expression. A youthful ensemble drama that draws heavily on the author's own experience.

theme_summary_ja: 岩手県の地方都市を舞台に、職場で親しくなった同僚の男が、東日本大震災後に消息を絶ったことをきっかけに、語り手がその人物の知られざる一面を辿っていく物語。表向きは穏やかだった友人の、これまで知らなかった素顔が少しずつ明らかになっていく。震災という出来事を背景に、人と人との関係の不確かさや、失われたものへの思いが静かに描かれる。喪失と記憶をめぐる作品である。
theme_summary_en: Set in a small city in Iwate Prefecture, the story follows a narrator who, after a close workplace friend goes missing in the aftermath of the Great East Japan Earthquake, begins tracing that friend's unknown side. Little by little, unfamiliar facets of a man who had always seemed gentle and unremarkable come to light. Against the backdrop of the disaster, the novel quietly renders the uncertainty of human relationships and a lingering attachment to what has been lost. A work concerned with loss and memory.

notes: 若竹千佐子は63歳での受賞で、デビュー作としては当時最年長級として話題に
theme_summary_ja: インド・チェンナイで日本語教師として働く女性が、大洪水の後、川から溢れ出た泥の中から様々な物やがれきが見つかる様子を目にする物語。泥にまみれた品々をきっかけに、教え子や周囲の人々にまつわる不思議なエピソードが次々と語られていく。現実と幻想が入り混じったインドの猥雑で生命力あふれる日常が、生き生きと描かれる。異国での暮らしと、そこに堆積する記憶を描いた作品である。
notes_en: Chisako Wakatake drew attention for winning at age 63, one of the oldest debut-work winners at the time.
theme_summary_en: A woman working as a Japanese-language teacher in Chennai, India, watches as a great flood recedes, leaving all manner of objects and debris washed out of the river and half-buried in mud. Triggered by these mud-caked relics, a string of strange episodes involving her students and the people around her unfolds. The novel vividly renders the chaotic, vital, everyday texture of India, where the real and the fantastical intermingle. A work about life in a foreign land and the layers of memory that accumulate there.

work_ja: おらおらでひとりいぐも
notes: 若竹千佐子は63歳での受賞で、デビュー作としては当時最年長級として話題に
theme_summary_ja: 夫を亡くし、東京で一人暮らしを続ける74歳の女性を主人公にした物語。彼女の胸のうちには、故郷である東北の言葉（方言）で語りかけてくる、もう一人の自分自身とも言うべき複数の声が響いている。上京してからの半生や夫との思い出を振り返りながら、老いた一人の女性がこれからの人生をどう生きるかを見つめていく。老いと孤独、そして自分自身との対話を描いた作品である。
notes_en: Chisako Wakatake drew attention for winning at age 63, one of the oldest debut-work winners at the time.
theme_summary_en: The protagonist is a seventy-four-year-old widow living alone in Tokyo. Inside her, several voices -- like other selves -- speak to her in the Tohoku dialect of her home region. Looking back over the decades since she left home and over her memories of her late husband, she considers how she, now an old woman, ought to live out the rest of her life. A work depicting old age, solitude, and a dialogue with oneself.

theme_summary_ja: 東京から北海道の中学校に転校してきた少年を主人公にした物語。新しい学校では、生徒たちの間に暗黙の上下関係や暴力が根を張っており、主人公はその歪んだ人間関係に次第に巻き込まれていく。表面的には平穏に見える地方の共同体の内側に潜む閉塞感と暴力性が、少年の視点から徐々に露わになっていく。思春期における暴力と沈黙の構造を描いた作品である。
theme_summary_en: A boy transfers from Tokyo to a junior high school in Hokkaido, only to find that an unspoken hierarchy and casual violence run deep among his new classmates, and he is gradually drawn into these warped relationships. Through the boy's eyes, the novel slowly exposes the suffocation and latent brutality beneath the outwardly peaceful surface of a rural community. A work depicting the structures of violence and silence within adolescence.

theme_summary_ja: ビットコインのマイニング（採掘）用サーバーの管理を任されているIT企業の会社員を主人公にした物語。同僚の男から送られてくる「世界一だめな飛行機」の写真をめぐるやり取りを通して、価値とは何か、通貨とは何かという問いが浮かび上がっていく。旧約聖書に登場するバベルの塔の建設者ニムロデ（ニムロッド）のモチーフが、現代のデジタル経済と重ね合わされる。仮想通貨時代における価値と欲望を問う作品である。
theme_summary_en: The protagonist is an IT-company employee tasked with managing servers used for Bitcoin mining. Through an exchange of photographs of "the world's worst airplane" sent by a colleague, questions arise about the nature of value and currency itself. The motif of Nimrod, builder of the Tower of Babel in the Old Testament, is layered onto the contemporary digital economy. A work that interrogates value and desire in the age of cryptocurrency.

theme_summary_ja: 判定負けを喫し、選手生命の岐路に立たされたボクサーの青年を主人公にした物語。これまでとは全く異なるスタイルを持つ新しいトレーナーの指導を受けながら、主人公は自分の身体やボクシングそのものと改めて向き合っていく。勝敗だけでは測れない、闘うことそのものの意味を模索する主人公の姿が描かれる。身体を通して自己を再生していく過程を描いた作品である。
work_en: Round One, One Minute Thirty-Four Seconds
theme_summary_en: A young boxer, having lost a decision and now standing at a crossroads in his career, begins training under a new coach whose methods differ entirely from anything he has known. Under this new guidance, he is forced to reconsider his own body and the sport of boxing itself. The novel portrays his search for a meaning in fighting that cannot be measured by wins and losses alone. A work depicting the process of remaking the self through the body.

work_ja: むらさきのスカートの女
theme_summary_ja: 近所に住む「むらさきのスカートの女」と呼ばれる、どこか浮いた存在の女性を執拗に観察し続ける語り手の物語。語り手は、その女性が自分の職場でアルバイトを始めるよう仕向け、彼女の一挙一動を監視するように見つめ続ける。親しくなりたいのか監視したいのか判然としない、歪んだ執着と孤独が語り手自身の姿を通して浮かび上がっていく。他者への一方的な思い入れとその危うさを描いた作品である。
work_en: The Woman in the Purple Skirt
theme_summary_en: The narrator obsessively observes a somewhat conspicuous neighborhood woman known as "the woman in the purple skirt." She maneuvers this woman into taking a part-time job at her own workplace, then watches her every move as if keeping her under surveillance. Through the narrator's own behavior -- is she seeking friendship or merely to watch? -- a warped obsession and loneliness gradually come into focus. A work depicting the perilousness of one-sided fixation on another person.

theme_summary_ja: 長崎近郊の島にある、一族が代々所有してきた古い納屋の敷地に生い茂った「背高泡立草」という雑草を、親族たちが集まって刈り取ろうとする物語。草刈りという日常的な作業を通して、一族の歴史や、そこに関わった様々な人々の記憶が幾層にも重ね合わされていく。過去の世代から現在へと続く、土地と家族の記憶が丁寧に紡がれる。土地に刻まれた家族の歴史を見つめた作品である。
theme_summary_en: On an island near Nagasaki, relatives gather to clear away the tall goldenrod weeds that have overgrown the grounds of an old barn their family has owned for generations. Through this everyday act of clearing brush, the family's history and the memories of the many people connected to it are layered one upon another. The memory of land and family, carried down from past generations into the present, is patiently woven together. A work that contemplates a family's history as inscribed in the land itself.

theme_summary_ja: 沖縄で、地域の郷土資料を集めた小さな私設資料館を営む女性を主人公にした物語。ある台風の夜、資料館の敷地に一頭の馬が迷い込んでくる。オンラインのクイズに答える在宅の仕事をしながら暮らす彼女の日常と、沖縄という土地に積み重なってきた記憶や資料の断片が重ね合わされていく。忘れられていくものを記録し、留めておくことの意味を問う作品である。
theme_summary_en: The protagonist runs a small, privately-operated museum of local historical materials in Okinawa. One typhoon night, a horse wanders onto the museum grounds. Her daily life -- supported by remote work answering online quizzes -- is layered together with the fragments of memory and documentation that have accumulated on the land of Okinawa. A work questioning what it means to record and preserve what is being forgotten.

theme_summary_ja: 教員採用試験を控えながら、社会人ラグビーチームでの活動も続ける、自分を律することに強くこだわる青年を主人公にした物語。二人の女性との関係を同時に続けながら、主人公は自らを理想的な人間だと信じて疑わない。しかし、その自己像は徐々に現実との間にひずみを生じさせていく。自己欺瞞と破綻に向かっていく青年の内面を、乾いた筆致で描いた作品である。
theme_summary_en: The protagonist is a young man, fiercely disciplined, who is preparing for the teacher certification exam while continuing to play for an amateur rugby club. Even as he maintains simultaneous relationships with two women, he remains convinced, without a shred of doubt, that he is an admirable person. But this self-image gradually begins to warp against reality. Written in a dry, detached style, the novel traces a young man's descent into self-deception and collapse.

theme_summary_ja: 学校にも家庭にもうまく馴染めない女子高生が、あるアイドルを「推す」ことだけを生きる支えにしている物語。推しているアイドルがファンを殴ったとされる炎上騒動をきっかけに、主人公自身の生活や心の均衡も揺らいでいく。「推す」という行為が、自分自身の身体や生活感覚とどう結びついているかが、痛切な筆致で描かれる。現代のファン文化と生きづらさを重ね合わせた作品である。
theme_summary_en: A high-school girl who fits in neither at school nor at home finds that supporting -- "oshi-ing" -- a particular idol is the only thing sustaining her life. When the idol becomes embroiled in a scandal after allegedly striking a fan, the protagonist's own life and inner equilibrium begin to crumble. The novel depicts, with piercing intensity, how the act of devoted fandom becomes bound up with her own body and sense of everyday life. A work that maps contemporary fan culture onto the difficulty of simply living.

theme_summary_ja: ドイツの大学都市に留学中の日本人女性のもとに、東日本大震災の津波で亡くなったはずの友人が、何事もなかったかのように訪ねてくる物語。コロナ禍で孤立した異国での生活の中、死者と生者、記憶と現実の境界が曖昧になっていく。震災から時を経てもなお消えない喪失感が、幻想的な手法を交えて描かれる。異国での孤独と、震災の記憶をめぐる作品である。
theme_summary_en: A Japanese woman studying at a German university city is visited, as though nothing were amiss, by a friend who supposedly died in the tsunami following the Great East Japan Earthquake. Isolated in a foreign country during the pandemic, she finds the boundaries between the dead and the living, between memory and reality, growing indistinct. Using elements of the fantastical, the novel captures a sense of loss that has not faded even years after the disaster. A work about loneliness abroad and the enduring memory of the earthquake.

theme_summary_ja: 李琴峰による2021年発表の作品。絶海の孤島を舞台に、記憶を失った少女が浜辺で発見されるところから物語が始まる。女性が指導的立場を担うこの島の社会には独自の言語や信仰体系が存在し、少女は自らの出自とこの島の成り立ちの秘密を辿っていく。ジェンダーや共同体のあり方、言語そのものを問い直す思弁的な物語。
work_en: The Island Where Red Spider Lilies Bloom
theme_summary_en: A 2021 work by Li Kotomi. Set on a remote, isolated island, the story begins when a girl with no memory is found washed up on a beach. The island's society, in which women hold positions of leadership, has its own language and belief system, and the girl comes to trace both her own origins and the secret of how the island itself came to be. A speculative narrative that reexamines gender, the nature of community, and language itself.

theme_summary_ja: 砂川文次による作品。東京で自転車便のメッセンジャーとして働く若い男を主人公に、日々の労働の中に募る苛立ちと衝動的な暴力性を描く。契約や規則に縛られながらも肉体を酷使して都市を駆け抜ける主人公は、ある出来事をきっかけに転落していく。現代の非正規労働と社会からの疎外感を鋭く切り取った作品。
theme_summary_en: A work by Sunagawa Bunji. Centered on a young man working as a bicycle courier in Tokyo, the novel depicts the mounting irritation and impulsive violence bred by his daily labor. Bound by contracts and rules yet pushing his body to its limits as he races through the city, the protagonist is sent into a downward spiral by a single incident. A work that sharply captures precarious, non-regular labor and the alienation it breeds in contemporary society.

work_ja: おいしいごはんが食べられますように
theme_summary_ja: 高瀬隼子による作品。職場を舞台に、いつも手作りの菓子や料理を振る舞う同僚の女性と、彼女に微妙な違和感や苛立ちを募らせていく同僚たちの関係を描く。「おいしい食事」や「思いやり」とされる行為の裏にある支配や同調圧力を、静かで意地悪な視線で炙り出す。職場の人間関係に潜む善意と悪意の境界を問う小説。
work_en: So You Can Eat Delicious Meals
theme_summary_en: A work by Takase Junko. Set in an office, it depicts the relationship between a female colleague who is forever bringing homemade sweets and dishes to share and the coworkers who grow increasingly, subtly irritated and uneasy with her. With a quiet, sharp-eyed cruelty, the novel exposes the control and conformist pressure lurking beneath acts framed as "delicious food" and "consideration." A novel that questions the border between goodwill and malice in workplace relationships.

theme_summary_ja: 井戸川射子による作品。ショッピングモールで働く中年の女性を中心に、家族や子との関係、日常の中の小さな喜びや戸惑いを詩的な文体で綴る。時間の流れや記憶が交錯する独特の語りで、母であることや老いていくことの感覚を描き出す。淡々とした日常描写を通じて生きることの手触りを浮かび上がらせる作品。
work_en: Oh, the Joys of This World
theme_summary_en: A work by Idogawa Shako. Centered on a middle-aged woman who works at a shopping mall, the novel renders, in poetic prose, her relationships with family and children and the small joys and uncertainties of everyday life. Through a distinctive narrative voice in which the flow of time and memory intersect, it captures the felt sense of being a mother and of growing older. A work that, through understated depictions of daily life, brings out the very texture of living.

theme_summary_ja: 佐藤厚志による作品。東日本大震災の津波で妻を失った造園業の男性を主人公に、被災地である宮城の沿岸部で再婚相手や息子と共に日々を営みながらも、消えることのない喪失感と向き合う姿を描く。震災から年月が経ってなお残る心の傷と、それでも続いていく生活の営みを静かな筆致で描いた作品。
theme_summary_en: A work by Sato Atsushi. The protagonist, a landscaper who lost his wife in the tsunami following the Great East Japan Earthquake, goes on living in coastal Miyagi with his new wife and son, all the while confronting a sense of loss that never quite fades. Written in a quiet style, the novel depicts both the wounds that linger years after the disaster and the ongoing rhythm of daily life that continues in spite of them.

notes: 市川沙央は自身も重度身体障害を持つ当事者としての作品で大きな話題に
theme_summary_ja: 市川沙央による作品。先天性の筋疾患により重い身体障害を抱え、施設で暮らす女性を主人公とする。彼女は紙の本を読むことが困難な自らの身体を通して、健常者中心に作られてきた出版文化・読書文化への違和感を綴り、また自らの性や生殖への欲望を率直に語る。障害者の身体性と社会の「当たり前」を鋭く問い直す作品。
notes_en: Sao Ichikawa, who herself lives with a severe physical disability, drew major attention for a work written from that lived experience.
theme_summary_en: A work by Ichikawa Sao. The protagonist is a woman with severe physical disabilities from a congenital muscular disease, living in a care facility. Through the lens of a body for which reading a printed book is itself a struggle, she voices her discomfort with a publishing and reading culture built around the able-bodied, and speaks frankly of her own sexual desires and longing for reproduction. A work that sharply interrogates disabled embodiment and society's unexamined assumptions of "normalcy."

theme_summary_ja: 九段理江による作品。犯罪者を「同情されるべき存在」として処遇する高層施設の建設に携わる女性建築家を主人公に、AIによる言語生成が浸透した近未来の東京を描く。犯罪と赦し、言葉の変容とテクノロジーが社会や個人の思考に及ぼす影響を問う思弁的な作品。
theme_summary_en: A work by Kudan Rie. The protagonist is a female architect involved in designing a high-rise facility that treats criminals as figures deserving of sympathy, set in a near-future Tokyo saturated with AI-generated language. A speculative work that asks questions about crime and forgiveness, the transformation of language, and the effects of technology on both society and individual thought.

work_ja: サンショウウオの四十九日
theme_summary_ja: 朝比奈秋による作品。結合双生児として一つの身体を分かち合ってきた姉妹の一方が亡くなり、残された一人が四十九日の間、死者と自らの境界が溶け合うような感覚の中で過ごす様子を描く。二人でありながら一つでもあった身体の記憶を通して、自己と他者、生と死の境界を問い直す作品。
theme_summary_en: A work by Asahina Aki. One of a pair of conjoined twin sisters, who have shared a single body their whole lives, dies, and the novel follows the surviving twin through the forty-nine days of mourning, during which the boundary between herself and her dead sister seems to dissolve. Through the memory of a body that was at once two and one, the novel reexamines the boundary between self and other, and between life and death.

theme_summary_ja: 松永K三蔵による作品。建物の外装修繕会社に転職した中年男性が、社内の登山サークルをきっかけに六甲山登山にのめり込んでいく。職場では変人扱いされながらも正規の登山道を外れる過酷な「バリエーションルート」を単独で行く先輩社員の生き方に触れ、会社勤めの日常と山でしか得られない生の実感との間で揺れ動く姿を描く。
theme_summary_en: A work by Matsunaga K. Sanzo. A middle-aged man who has taken a job at a building-exterior renovation company becomes drawn into mountaineering on Mount Rokko through the company's climbing club. Regarded as an oddball at the office, a senior colleague who solos brutal off-trail "variation routes" beyond the marked paths becomes an example that shakes the protagonist, who finds himself torn between the routine of company life and a sense of being truly alive that only the mountain can provide.

theme_summary_ja: 安堂ホセによる作品。南太平洋の島を舞台にした国際的な男性コンテスト番組で、日本代表として参加した男と、彼から過去に暴力的な傷を負わされた語り手が十数年ぶりに再会する。人種や国籍、外見によって値踏みされる身体、そして幼馴染だった二人の間に横たわる暴力と赦しがたい記憶を鋭い筆致で描く。
theme_summary_en: A work by Ando Hose. On a South Pacific island where an international men's beauty-contest television show is being filmed, a man representing Japan and the narrator -- who was violently harmed by him years before -- meet again after more than a decade apart. With incisive prose, the novel depicts bodies appraised by race, nationality, and appearance, and the violence and unforgivable memories that lie between two men who were once childhood friends.

work_ja: ゲーテはすべてを言った
theme_summary_ja: 鈴木結生による作品。著名なゲーテ研究者である主人公が、家族との食卓でお茶のパッケージに記された見慣れないゲーテの言葉に出会うところから始まる。その言葉の出典を探して膨大な原典を渉猟し、自らの長い研究者人生の記憶を辿り直す過程を通じて、創造や学問とは何かという問いに迫る知的な作品。
theme_summary_en: A work by Suzuki Yuki. The story opens when its protagonist, a renowned Goethe scholar, encounters an unfamiliar quotation attributed to Goethe printed on a tea package at the family dinner table. As he combs through a vast body of primary sources searching for the quotation's true origin, he retraces the memories of his own long career as a researcher, in an intellectually probing work that asks what creation and scholarship truly are.

theme_summary_ja: 鳥山まことによる作品。建築士だった初代の住人が魂を込めて設計した一軒の家に、三代にわたって暮らした人々の人生を、家を訪れたある青年のスケッチをきっかけに呼び起こしていく。丸柱や漆喰の壁など建物の細部に刻まれた記憶を通して、住人たちの喜びや悲しみが時を超えて蘇る、静かな余韻を残す物語。
theme_summary_en: A work by Toriyama Makoto. A house designed with great care by its first owner, an architect, has been home to three generations of residents, and the novel calls forth their lives through the occasion of a young man's visit and the sketch he draws of the house. Through memories inscribed in details of the building -- its round pillars, its plastered walls -- the joys and sorrows of its inhabitants are revived across time, in a quietly resonant story.

theme_summary_ja: 畠山丑雄による作品。かつて芥子栽培や阿片製造が行われ、満州とも縁のあった大阪の土地を舞台に、絶望の淵にいる青年が「先生」と呼ばれる人物に導かれ、銅鐸をはじめとする土地の来歴や封印されてきた声と向き合っていく。昭和と令和をつなぐ壮大な歴史と、どこか人間くさい滑稽さが同居する物語。
theme_summary_en: A work by Hatakeyama Ushiosu. Set on a plot of land in Osaka once used for growing poppies and producing opium, with historical ties to Manchuria, the novel follows a young man on the brink of despair who is guided by a figure known only as "Sensei" to confront the land's history -- bronze bells among its relics -- and the voices that had long been sealed away there. A story that combines a sweeping history spanning the Showa and Reiwa eras with a distinctly human, comic warmth.

theme_summary_ja: 小砂川チトによる作品。AIの普及により職を失った女性が、VRゲームの世界で「ゾンビ」となった死骸を回収する掃除婦として働き始める。仮想空間での単調な労働を通して、AI時代における仕事の意味や、誰かに必要とされることへの渇望を静かに見つめる作品。
theme_summary_en: A work by Kosunagawa Chito. A woman who has lost her job to the spread of AI takes work inside a VR game world as a cleaner who collects the corpses of "zombies." Through her monotonous labor in this virtual space, the novel quietly examines what work means in the age of AI, and the deep longing to be needed by someone.
